About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

Purpose:

The Product Architect owns the successful delivery, adoption and ongoing success of Visa Intelligent Authorisation (VIA) for strategically important clients, ensuring that client needs, product capabilities, implementation activities and delivery outcomes remain aligned throughout the onboarding lifecycle.

Serving as the connective tissue between Product, Sales Engineering, Client Services, Delivery teams and the client, the Product Architect provides continuity from pre-sales discovery through production stabilisation, ensuring requirements are understood, solution designs are viable, delivery remains aligned to client needs, and product evolution is informed by implementation reality.

This role exists because complex onboarding programmes require more than delivery management and more than product ownership. They require an individual who can operate across both worlds, challenge assumptions, navigate ambiguity, influence without authority, and remain accountable for the integrity of the client outcome.

The Product Architect owns neither the product roadmap nor the day-to-day management of the project plan. However, they remain accountable for the successful delivery and adoption of VIA for their assigned clients, ensuring that commercial commitments, solution design, product capabilities and implementation activities remain aligned from initial engagement through production stabilisation.

Key Responsibilities:

Client Ownership:

Act as the accountable Product lead for assigned strategic clients.

Own the successful delivery and adoption of VIA for assigned clients.

Maintain continuity from pre-sales engagement through production stabilisation.

Maintain accountability for implementation progress, delivery risks, solution integrity and client outcomes throughout the onboarding lifecycle.

Ensure client requirements, constraints, risks and dependencies are understood and managed throughout delivery.

Act as a trusted advisor to client stakeholders, helping align business objectives with product capabilities and implementation realities.

Escalate and drive resolution of issues that threaten delivery timelines, implementation success or client outcomes.

Solution Design & Requirements:

Lead requirements discovery and solution definition for complex onboarding engagements.

Challenge assumptions and requirements to ensure scope reflects genuine business needs.

Develop and maintain end-to-end solution designs covering technical, operational and product considerations.

Ensure solution designs balance client requirements, operational readiness, scalability and long-term product strategy.

Ensure that what is sold can be successfully implemented, operated and supported at scale.

Product & Delivery Alignment:

Act as the primary bridge between client implementation teams and VIA product teams.

Ensure delivery remains aligned to agreed solution intent and product capabilities.

Surface product gaps and advocate for enhancements supported by implementation evidence.

Provide implementation-driven insights that influence product strategy, onboarding frameworks and future platform investments.

Drive alignment between product decisions, implementation activities and client commitments.

Delivery Governance:

Provide architecture and product leadership throughout implementation.

Identify and mitigate technical, operational and onboarding risks.

Support Pilot exit and production readiness assessments for complex implementations.

Act as a senior authority within implementation governance forums, managing escalations, resolving ambiguity, and driving clear ownership across stakeholders.

Cut through organisational noise, competing priorities and conflicting viewpoints to maintain focus on delivery objectives and client outcomes.

Operate comfortably in situations where requirements, ownership, priorities or delivery paths are not yet fully defined, bringing structure and clarity to complex challenges.

Influence without formal authority, aligning client, product, operational and delivery teams around a common outcome.

Be accountable for the overall success of the implementation, regardless of where individual workstreams or delivery responsibilities reside within the organisation.

Proactively intervene when delivery risks, ownership gaps or organisational barriers threaten successful execution.

Drive stakeholders toward decisions and actions required to maintain implementation timelines and client commitments.

Problem Resolution & Continuous Improvement:

Troubleshoot complex integration, onboarding and production issues where required.

Capture lessons learned and convert implementation experience into reusable standards, guidance and onboarding patterns.

Contribute to improvements in product readiness, onboarding frameworks and client implementation practices.

Demonstrate a willingness to step beyond traditional role boundaries when required, contributing wherever necessary to keep implementations on track and achieve successful client outcomes.

Balance strategic leadership with hands-on execution, moving seamlessly between executive stakeholder discussions and detailed implementation problem solving.

Be prepared to do whatever is required to achieve the client outcome, whether leading executive escalations, facilitating workshops, removing delivery blockers, resolving implementation issues, or supporting activities outside traditional role boundaries.

Measures of Success:

Strategic clients successfully onboard and adopt VIA.

Client commitments are delivered successfully and sustainably.

Pilot and production milestones are achieved with strong operational readiness.

Delivery risks are identified early and resolved effectively.

Solution designs remain aligned to client objectives and product capabilities.

Product improvements are informed by implementation experience.

Stakeholders view the Product Architect as the accountable owner of the client outcome and successful delivery of VIA.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

8+ years of relevant professional experience with a Bachelor's Degree, or 6+ years with an Advanced Degree, or equivalent experience.

Experience leading complex client onboarding, implementation, transformation, or integration programmes within Payments, Financial Services, FinTech, or related industries.

Experience translating business requirements into scalable, operationally viable solution designs.

Strong understanding of payment processing, issuer or acquirer operations, authorization systems, fraud and risk management, or related financial services technologies.

Experience working directly with clients to define requirements, manage expectations, and drive successful implementation outcomes.

Experience operating across Product, Technology, Operations, Client Services, Delivery, and Sales Engineering functions.

Demonstrated ability to identify, manage, and mitigate technical, operational, commercial, and programme risks.

Experience influencing stakeholders and driving decisions without direct authority in matrixed organizations.

Experience managing implementation governance, issue resolution, and client escalations.

Proven ability to operate effectively in ambiguous environments where requirements, ownership, or delivery approaches may not be fully defined.

Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.

Experience collaborating within global, cross-functional teams.

Preferred Qualifications:

10+ years of experience in Payments, Financial Services, Banking, FinTech, or related industries.

Experience leading strategic client implementations involving complex integrations and multiple stakeholder groups.

Understanding of issuer processing, authorization decisioning, digital payments, fraud systems, and associated operational processes.

Experience supporting pilot execution, production readiness, and post-production stabilization activities.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a pragmatic delivery mindset.

Demonstrated accountability for delivering successful client outcomes regardless of organizational boundaries, workstream ownership, or functional responsibilities.

To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.

Group/Division
KLA has manufacturing sites worldwide. The Global Operations (GOPS) team, comprised of Manufacturing, Supply Chain Management, Manufacturing Engineering, Installation and Quality, builds our leading-edge technology. GOPS partners with KLA's global supply base and design engineering teams to develop new products, working continuously to build better, faster and more cost-efficient solutions.

What You'll Do

In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.

Effectively lead and manage supplier relationships.

Lead / Participate in supply chain management initiatives on lead time reduction, cost reduction, value engineering, quality, reliability, and OTD.

Understand company business requirements, market dynamics and trends, supply base and supply base capabilities.

Provide sophisticated problem resolution and cross functional support for supplier escalations and supply disruptions, by expediting supply recovery. Including creation of and report outs of executive summaries and presentations to senior management.

Partner with manufacturing to perform capacity analysis to support what-if scenarios, forecast changes, planning for production growth, and growth in spares business to support worldwide install base of tools.

Performs continuity of supply risk assessment and develops/implements mitigation strategies

Partner with manufacturing, design engineering, and manufacturing design engineering to ensure KLA and/or supplier-initiated supply chain relocations are successful

Drive assessment of raw parts cost, supplier quality, supplier capability and capacity (ramp-up / ramp-down), and supplier consolidation. 

Perform assessments and make recommendations related to inventory forecasting, timing of inventory receipts, excess and obsolete optimization / reduction, and order quantity optimization.   

Collaborates with production planning, supply chain, and master scheduling teams to propose supply chain solutions and strategic or tactical plans, drawing on business data, commodity insights, and product expertise.

Implement, manage and coordinate supplier contracts, SOWs, SLAs, NDAs and any other required supplier agreements.

Lead, co-ordinate, deployand manage supplier business reviews.  Continually drive improvements based on gap analysis against business requirements.

Drives corporate and divisional initiatives to achieve performance targets.

Crafts, implement and/or drives industry and company supply chain best practices.

Ensure adherence to corporate supply chain management best practices, policies, procedures and internal / external compliance requirements.

Strategic sourcing experience in the Semiconductor Capital Equipment, Aerospace, Defense or Medical equipment industries.

Any relevant certifications like PMP/CSCP/CPSM etc.

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience with Supply Chain Management in any industry or Experience with Engineering/Supply Chain Management within the Semiconductor Capital Equipment industry.

Must possess Commercial aptitudes.

The ability and desire to constantly learn is crucial.

Domestic and international travel is required (up to 20%).

Minimum Qualifications

Master's Level Degree and related work experience of 2 years; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 5 years; or equivalent work experience

Mindrift is running a research study on how people use their phones, apps and everyday digital tools, and how that differs across languages and cultures. We’re looking for native Hebrew speakers in New York to join a paid, 3-day in-person study in Midtown Manhattan. Why your language matters Most technology is still designed with English speakers in mind. This study helps researchers understand how people who communicate in Hebrew actually use their devices, so future products work better for them. What you’ll do Spend 1-3 days with our research team in Midtown Manhattan. Walk us through how you use your phone and favourite apps in daily life. Share examples of your everyday phone activity with the research team. You decide what’s included. Fill in a short questionnaire about your habits. Who we’re looking for 18+ and currently living in NYC. A native Hebrew speaker who grew up in Israel. You use Hebrew in everyday life: texting friends, email, notes. You’ve used a smartphone as your main personal phone for 3+ years. Comfortable communicating in English. Available for 3 consecutive days (Mon–Wed or Thu–Sat), starting October 16 on Friday. Not currently employed by a tech or AI company. Great fit for international students, people new to NYC, and anyone between jobs or with a flexible schedule. Compensation $100/hour, up to $2,400 for the full study. Simple and transparent Participation is voluntary and covered by a signed consent form that explains exactly what’s involved. You can ask questions at any point and stop whenever you like. How to apply Register on Mindrift and complete a short screening questionnaire. We’ll confirm your session dates once you’re shortlisted. Apply now

Job Description:
Under the direction of the Sterile Processing Department (SPD) Manager the Sterile Processing Shift Supervisor monitors daily operations in the SPD department, ensuring that technicians are trained in and abide by all departmental policies and procedures. Monitors productivity and quality of product of individual employees and of an assigned shift. Assists SPD Manager with budget monitoring. Participates with SPD Manager in planning for future needs and project implementation related to personnel, program development, instrumentation, equipment, interdepartmental relationships and department goals. Assesses and troubleshoots safety, instrument and equipment issues. Establishes and maintains professional rapport with medical, nursing and other staff. Assumes responsibilities for department as a whole in the absence of the SPD Manager.

Telemundo Utah is seeking a creative, highly motivated Creative Services Producer to join its marketing team. The Creative Services Producer collaborates with the Creative Services Manager and cross-functional teams to develop and execute promotional content, marketing initiatives, and community-focused projects across broadcast, streaming, digital, social, print, radio, outdoor, and experiential platforms. This role supports station priorities, special programming, news promotion, sales efforts, and community engagement activities through compelling and culturally relevant creative content.

The ideal candidate is a strong storyteller with exceptional writing, producing, shooting, editing, and motion graphics skills who understands how to connect with Hispanic audiences through engaging and culturally relevant content.

This position reports directly to the Creative Services Manager and works closely with News, Sales, Digital, and Community teams to support station marketing and promotional objectives.

Responsibilities

Write, shoot, edit, and produce station image, news, sales, topical, and special promotional content from concept through final delivery.

Create compelling content across broadcast, digital, streaming, OTT, social media, and emerging platforms.

Collaborate with the Creative Services Manager, internal and external stakeholders to develop creative campaigns, promotional content, and marketing projects while adhering to Telemundo and NBCUniversal brand standards.

Support annual Creative Services plans, station tentpoles, key initiatives, special programming, and major marketing priorities.

Collaborate on the development and execution of promotional campaigns, marketing efforts, and community-focused initiatives that support station objectives, audience engagement, and brand awareness.

Produce marketing and promotional materials for television, digital, social media, print, radio, outdoor, and experiential activations.

Operate DSLR and full-frame camera systems, professional audio equipment, and lighting packages for studio and field productions.

Transport, set up, and operate production equipment, including lighting, audio systems, wireless microphones, and related accessories.

Perform post-production editing, color correction, audio adjustments, graphic integration, voice-over synchronization, music selection, and final finishing utilizing Adobe Creative Cloud applications.

Partner with News, Sales, Digital, and Community teams to create news, image, branded, and promotional content while maintaining consistency across all platforms.

Ensure promotional content meets broadcast, legal, technical, and NBCUniversal quality standards.

Maintain production schedules, project trackers, standard operating procedures, and workflow processes that support efficient execution and delivery of projects.

Collaborate closely with newsroom, sales, digital, and community teams to support station initiatives and sponsorship opportunities.

Participate in sales meetings and assist with the development of sponsorship opportunities, branded content, and client-focused marketing solutions.

Support community engagement programs and partnership events that strengthen the station's visibility and relationships throughout the market.

Support emcee, hosting, speaking, and other public-facing opportunities as assigned to help elevate station talent and brand presence.

Coordinate with internal teams on promotional shoots, marketing initiatives, and community events.

Develop digital and print creative assets utilizing Adobe Creative Cloud applications.

Ensure station promotional vehicles and event assets are clean, presentable, and event-ready while coordinating with designated operational and maintenance resources as needed.

Assist the Creative Services Manager with special projects and assignments as needed.

Maintain flexibility to work nights, weekends, holidays, and extended hours as needed 24/7. Basic Qualifications

Fluency in Spanish and English, with exceptional written and verbal communication skills in both languages.

Minimum three (3) years of experience producing promotional, branding, commercial, marketing, or news content for television, media, agency, or related industries.

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Advertising, Communications, Production, Digital Media, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Demonstrated experience writing, producing, shooting, and editing video content.

Proficiency with Adobe Creative Cloud, including Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop, Illustrator, Audition, and Lightroom.

Experience operating professional video cameras, audio equipment, and lighting systems.

Strong scriptwriting and storytelling abilities.

Strong understanding of the U.S. Hispanic consumer.

Strong understanding of Microsoft 365 applications.

Ability to collaborate effectively across departments and contribute to community initiatives and events.

Must have unrestricted work authorization to work in the United States.

Must be 18 years or older.

Candidates must submit a resume/CV via www.nbcunicareers.com

Portfolio or demo reel of relevant work is strongly encouraged. Candidates should include a link when submitting their application, if available.

Must be willing to work in Salt Lake City, Utah.

Must be flexible to work evenings, weekends, holidays, and changing schedules as business needs require.

Must be willing to travel as needed.

Must possess a valid driver's license and maintain an acceptable driving record.

Desired Characteristics

Experience creating content and promotional efforts across broadcast, digital, social, streaming, and experiential platforms.

Prior experience working in Spanish-language television, media, or entertainment.

Familiarity with digital and social media performance metrics.

Strong motion graphics and design skills.

Experience supporting community engagement programs and local marketing efforts.

Advanced proficiency with Adobe Creative Cloud and demonstrated ability to create high-quality station image, commercial, branded, and promotional content.

Experience directing and producing promos, commercials, branded content, digital content, and news marketing projects.

Knowledge of WideOrbit and related media workflow systems is a plus.

Familiarity with evolving creative production tools and workflows.

Highly organized with strong attention to detail.

Ability to manage multiple assignments simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

Positive attitude, strong work ethic, and commitment to creative excellence.

Ability to receive feedback constructively and adapt quickly to changing priorities.

Strong team player who collaborates effectively across departments.

About this role:

Wells Fargo is seeking an Associate Personal Banker (SAFE) to join our National Branch. In this frontline role, you will build relationships with customers by supporting everyday banking needs through in‑branch interactions, scheduled conversations, and proactive outreach. You will learn about customers’ goals and connect them to the right banking products, services, and digital tools to help them manage their finances with confidence.

You will support account openings, service requests, and credit applications while working closely with branch teammates to deliver a consistent, high-quality customer experience. Success is driven by strong relationship building, sound judgment, and the ability to balance service with growth.

As a member of a leading financial institution, this role provides a strong foundation for long-term career growth and mobility, supported by Wells Fargo’s training and coaching.

In this role you will:

Build lasting customer relationships through proactive, meaningful conversations that support financial well-being and deepen engagement

Lead discovery-driven conversations to understand customer needs and connect them with relevant banking products, services, and solutions

Drive branch growth by identifying opportunities, promoting solutions, and making appropriate referrals to meet customer and business goals

Support everyday banking needs, including new account openings, service requests, and credit applications

Perform cash handling and teller line activities, accurately processing transactions while maintaining compliance and operational standards

Demonstrate comfort using and adopting digital tools and technologies to enhance the customer experience and support evolving banking needs

Deliver accurate, compliant service while exercising sound judgement within defined risk controls

Collaborate with branch teammates to coordinate seamless handoffs to licensed bankers or other specialists, ensuring customers are connected to the right expertise

Required Qualifications:

6+ months of interacting with customers experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

Desired Qualifications:

Prior experience in financial services or a highly regulated, customer-facing role, demonstrating comfort with structured processes, accuracy, and service expectations

Experience building trust-based customer relationships through active listening, follow-up, and consistent engagement

Comfort initiating outreach (calls, emails, or other channels) to strengthen relationships and  identify opportunities to support customer needs

Demonstrated comfort with digital tools and technology, with the ability to quickly learn new systems and confidently guide customers in adopting capabilities that enhance their banking experience

Ability to identify customer needs and connect them to appropriate solutions, including referrals when additional expertise is needed

Proven ability to collaborate with teammates and partners to resolve needs and deliver a seamless customer experience

Demonstrated ability to follow policies and regulations while identifying and escalating risk concerns

Job Expectations:

Ability to work a schedule that will include Saturdays

Support branch operations by flexing between cash handling and customer banking activities, with an emphasis on delivering strong service through account openings and ongoing account support.

Essential Functions

Phlebotomist I is responsible for accurately collecting patient specimens for diagnostic testing while working in a professional medical environment. This position functions as part of a dynamic and engaging team with a workload that ranges from fast-paced hospital settings and high/low volume clinics. Caregivers in this role will gain valuable experience and knowledge to help prepare them for workplace and career advancement.

The Phlebotomist I perform specimen collection using many different techniques such as venipuncture, capillary puncture, PIVO, and throat swab collections. These caregivers collect specimens from patients of various acuities, such as Outpatient, Emergency Department, and Inpatient – including newborns, patients in intensive care, and all other areas of the hospital. They are at the forefront of patient care and adhere to and enforce the standards for laboratory compliance and safety regulations.

Adherence to personal protective requirements in inpatient and/or outpatient settings, including but not limited to gowns, gloves, lab coats, face shields, and masks.

Intermountain Caregivers in this role will communicate procedures and instructions with patients and family members and demonstrate empathy during every interaction. They will also have opportunities for growth, developing skills such as:

Patient registration

Participation in CODE response teams

Training and mentoring new staff

Specimen Processing

Participation in special projects

Other laboratory responsibilities as required by site or assigned by the team or department leader.

This position requires organizational skills, as well as the ability to navigate multiple computer systems, work well as a member of a team, and maintain a clean and safe work environment. Candidates applying for a phlebotomy role are resilient and can manage stressful situations professionally.

Ability to take on-call shifts and participate in holiday rotations, according to department or facility needs.

Job Description:

The Retain Cloud Product Owner – Senior Associate is the dedicated product and platform owner for Retain Cloud, the firm’s resource planning and scheduling platform, within the Enterprise Applications Support team. Based in Crowe’s Hyderabad office and working closely with US-based stakeholders, this role combines hands-on administration and configuration with day-to-day product ownership: managing the Retain backlog and roadmap, translating business needs into well-defined epics and user stories, coordinating vendor releases, and driving adoption as additional business units move onto the platform.

This position takes Retain beyond break/fix support. The Product Owner partners with the Retain business owner, business unit resource management teams, the Solutions support team, and the Retain vendor to keep the platform stable, secure, and aligned with firm priorities. As Retain moves into steady-state operations, the role will also be cross-trained on other enterprise applications supported by the team.

 

Key Responsibilities

 

Product Ownership and Backlog Management:

 

Own the Retain Cloud product backlog in ServiceNow, capturing, refining, and prioritizing demands, epics, and user stories with clear acceptance criteria.

Partner with the Retain business owner and business unit leaders to translate business goals into a product roadmap, release plan, and prioritized backlog.

Lead requirements gathering and backlog refinement sessions, make day-to-day prioritization decisions, and escalate trade-offs that affect scope, timeline, or investment.

Confirm that delivered changes meet the intended business need and are ready for release, coordinating user acceptance testing (UAT) with business users.

Track adoption, data quality, and support trends to measure value and guide priorities.

Platform Administration and Configuration

Serve as the primary technical administrator for Retain Cloud, configuring security profiles, skills, scheduling units, booking components, dropdown values, and other system settings.

Manage user access and role assignments through the ServiceNow access request process, and support periodic access reviews with business approvers.

Prepare, run, and validate mass booking and other data loads in UAT and production.

Monitor integrations and daily data feeds, including worker and skills data from Workday, and coordinate the resolution of feed and data issues.

Maintain configuration documentation and follow the firm’s change management process.

Release and Vendor Management

Act as the primary liaison with the Retain vendor: log and track support cases, escalate defects, and monitor vendor SLA performance.

Review vendor release notes, assess the impact of each Retain Cloud release, and plan and execute regression testing.

Communicate upcoming releases, resolved issues, and new features to support teams and users, and confirm that incidents addressed in a release are closed afterward.

Business Unit Onboarding and Adoption

Lead configuration and readiness work for business units onboarding to Retain Cloud, including requirements, data migration and reconciliation, UAT, and cutover planning.

oordinate the timing of changes and rollouts with business unit operations leaders to avoid busy season and filing-deadline conflicts.

Develop training materials and job aids, and help resource managers adopt new features.

Support and Continuous Improvement

Serve as the Solutions-level (L3) escalation point for Retain incidents: reproduce issues in the test environment, capture diagnostics, manage problem records, and provide workarounds.

Build and maintain the Retain knowledge base so Services and Troubleshooting teams can resolve common issues quickly and consistently.

Analyze ticket trends to find recurring issues and drive permanent fixes or enhancements.

Support Retain reporting needs by producing accurate scheduling and resource data for resource managers and leadership.

 

 Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

3–5 years of experience in enterprise SaaS application administration, business systems analysis, or product ownership.

At least 2 years of hands-on experience administering, configuring, or supporting Retain (Retain Cloud strongly preferred); deep experience with a comparable resource management platform will be considered.

Experience supporting resource management or scheduling teams in a professional services environment (audit, tax, or consulting) preferred.

Experience managing a backlog and writing epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria in ServiceNow, Azure DevOps, Jira, or a similar tool.

Working knowledge of ServiceNow ITSM and ITIL practices.

Experience with Workday or other HR system integrations and data loads is a plus.

Product Owner certification (such as CSPO or PSPO) preferred.

Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and working knowledge of Microsoft 365 and SharePoint.

 

Requirements

This is a hybrid position. The selected candidate must live within commute distance of the Crowe office in Hyderabad, India, and be able to travel to the office as needed.

Ability to work during US business hours collaborate with US-based stakeholders, with flexibility for releases, go-lives, and critical escalations.

Estimate an annual average of 10–15% overtime. Overtime will be required to meet critical deadlines and during busy season months.

Excellent written and verbal English communication skills for engaging US-based leaders.

Ability to work independently with broad direction and little supervision while collaborating effectively across a geographically dispersed team.

Retain applications for business lead and business unit representatives

Business unit resource managers and operations leaders

Enterprise Applications Support Solutions team

Services and Troubleshooting support teams

Retain vendor support and product teams

HR technology and data integration teams (such as Workday)

ServiceNow platform, project management, and IT leadership teams

The staff RN utilizes the nursing process by use of technology, therapeutic intervention, evidence-based practice and coordination of care with other health team members.

Plan: Uses assessment information and critical thinking skills to collaboratively develop individualized plan of care. Actively seeks patient, family, team, and physician involvement to develop plan of care including needed education. Collaboratively plans and prepares patients for further support needs once the current episode of care outcomes are met (i.e., teaching, referrals, and follow-up).

The Transportation Team is a collaborative and dynamic group of seven attorneys, one paralegal, and two legal secretaries. Job Description:
The Registered Nurse (RN) is a professional caregiver who assumes responsibility and accountability for assessing, planning, implementing, and evaluating the care of patients. The staff RN utilizes the nursing process by use of technology, therapeutic intervention, evidence-based practice and coordination of care with other health team members.
Start your next chapter with us and receive a $20,000 Sign-On Bonus! We’re looking for dedicated professionals to join our team and help us deliver exceptional care to our communities.

Position Details

·         Benefits Eligible: Full time benefits eligible

·         Shift Details: 30 hours/week, mid shift, three 10-hour shifts per week

·         Department: Emergency Department

·         Primary Location: Platte Valley Hospital

·         Additional Details: One year of licensed RN experience in an Emergency Department required.

Essential Functions

Assess: Performs appropriate assessment of physical, social, and psychological status (including cognitive, communicative, and developmental skills as appropriate). Seeks and evaluates information acquired from other members of interdisciplinary team: patient, family, physician, non-nursing disciplines, support staff, others.

Plan: Uses assessment information and critical thinking skills to collaboratively develop individualized plan of care. Actively seeks patient, family, team, and physician involvement to develop plan of care including needed education. Collaboratively plans and prepares patients for further support needs once the current episode of care outcomes are met (i.e., teaching, referrals, and follow-up).

Implement: Directs the interdisciplinary care team via delegation, coordination, and collaboration as appropriate. Provides or delegates care consistent with plan of care, guidelines of care and professional licensure provisions. Demonstrates the ability to set priorities and to coordinate and organize patient care delivery through effectively managing time, supplies, and resources.

Evaluate: Evaluates patient response to interventions through review of achievement of goals, clinical outcomes, patient, and family satisfaction. Revises plan of care as indicated and reassesses changes as appropriate.

Professionalism: Promotes nursing profession and participate in development of others.
Integrates legal and ethical standards into practice, complies with regulatory standards, practices within scope of licensure, provides accurate & timely documentation, and understands legal implications of care delivery.

Current license to practice as a Registered Nurse in state of practice. Valid compact licenses must be transferred to the state of practice within 60 days of the start of employment.

About the Role:

As a AI Native Software Engineer, you direct AI agents to build products and solutions, rather than writing code directly. You leverage AI coding agents to replace manual tasks, build and ship entire applications and basic agents end-to-end. You're a full-stack product builder who thinks in terms of "I need to solve this customer problem" and orchestrates AI to get there. You are measured by the speed of delivery and the robustness of what you ship, not the volume of your commits.

You Will:

Build complete applications, workflow automations, and basic agents within your team's product area using AI coding agents

Translate customer needs into buildable specifications and ship solutions from requirements through deployment

Instrument solutions to track usage and outcomes, iterating based on what you learn

Evaluate AI-generated output against Remitly's standards for security, privacy, reliability, and quality before shipping

Participate in customer conversations to understand acute problems and identify automation opportunities

Document your approaches, effective prompts, and patterns for the team

You Have:

Proficiency with AI coding agents for end-to-end application development

Ability to write effective prompts and iterate to achieve desired outcomes

Understanding of full-stack applications: frontend, backend, data, and infrastructure

Familiarity with common architectural patterns (web applications, APIs, databases, queues)

Awareness of fundamental design principles, common UI/UX patterns, and basic product development concepts

Ability to read and interpret basic analytics (usage metrics, conversion rates, error rates)

Strong communication skills and a collaborative, learning-oriented mindset

Content Author

Job Description

The Content Author is an entry point into the content team's career path, combining hands-on content authorship with full ownership of the content production process. This role analyzes source material from multiple resources and writes, edits, and updates clear, accurate, customer-facing content, while also performing the technical production tasks — coding, copyreading, merging, rendering, loading, and validating — needed to move that content through the team's systems and into publication. The Content Author works under the guidance of more senior team members while building independent proficiency in the team's content, processes, and systems, with the goal of taking on progressively broader responsibility over time. Specific product knowledge is not required at entry; the role is designed around generalizable content and systems skills that apply across the team's product portfolio.

Key Responsibilities 

Read source material from multiple places and write, edit, and update content so it's clear and correct, with guidance from senior team members. 

Handle the full content production process in Adobe Experience Manager (AEM): coding, copyreading, editing, merging, DITA formatting, and checking content. 

Turn confusing, incomplete, or mixed-up source material into clear, well-organized content for customers. 

Take ownership of your own content's accuracy and completeness; work independently on familiar tasks and ask for help on harder ones. 

Spot routine content problems, fix what you can, and know when to ask for help on anything unclear. 

Meet deadlines by managing your own workload and working well with teammates. 

Help test and review content to make sure it works and reads well across different formats. 

Suggest small process improvements when you spot them. 

Leverage strong product knowledge to enhance our workflow and content, for strategic products. 

Learn the team's content, systems, and tools, and pick up general product knowledge over time. 

Required Qualifications

Process-oriented: comfortable following and improving structured, multi-step content workflows. 

Attention to detail: consistently accurate, complete, and quality-checked work. 

Strong writing skills: clear, well-organized, professional writing across content types. 

Strong sense of voice: able to write and edit in a consistent, appropriate tone and style. 

Ability to deal with ambiguity: works effectively from incomplete, conflicting, or multi-source information and knows when to escalate. 

General product knowledge: comfortable learning new product context quickly; deep expertise in any single product is not required at entry. 

Works successfully in a team environment and understands team member roles. 

Preferred Qualifications 

Exposure to AI-assisted content tools or workflows. 

Familiarity with knowledge maps or other structured-content models. 

Basic content or data analytics skills. 

Experience with DITA or other structured-authoring frameworks. 

Experience working in a component content management system (CCMS). 

Broader content creation experience (e.g., digital, consumer-facing, or SEO-oriented content). 

Strong product knowledge in a strategic product area.

What if the AI agents you architect empower legal professionals to act with sharper judgment and greater leverage, using tools that are themselves AI-native and multiply what you and your team can ship?

Our agent platform team builds and ships using AI-native engineering practices: agentic coding tools that let a small, senior group move at a pace well beyond traditional engineering throughput. That's how this team builds the infrastructure, tooling, and observability our AI agents need to run reliably at scale, often several efforts at once. We're also in the middle of rethinking how we deploy and operate agents in production, pushing quality and safety checks earlier in the pipeline and raising our bar for release velocity and stability. As our Lead AI Engineer, you'll set technical direction across that portfolio, moving fluidly between the initiatives that matter most and shaping how a highly capable, senior team builds the next generation of legal AI agents.

About the Role

In this opportunity as a Lead AI Engineer, you will:

Set technical architecture and direction across the team's highest-priority initiatives, spanning core agent infrastructure, new internal tooling, and production reliability.

Provide hands-on technical leadership wherever it matters most, flexing across the team's highest-priority initiatives rather than being locked into a single fixed workstream.

Architect and build production AI agent systems on top of modern LLM APIs, agent SDKs, and orchestration/runtime infrastructure, designed to scale and integrate cleanly with existing platform services.

Design agent observability and evaluation practices (tracing, automated evals, and quality/drift detection) so regressions in agent behavior get caught before they reach customers.

Advance how the team deploys and operates AI agents in production, deepening practices like progressive/feature-flagged rollout and earlier-stage quality signals so releases get both faster and safer over time.

Drive cross-cutting design reviews and technical decisions (RFCs/ADRs) to keep new systems coherent as multiple initiatives move in parallel.

Mentor and raise the technical bar for a senior engineering team, including how they use AI-native, agentic development practices to multiply their own output.

Partner with product and engineering leadership to translate strategic priorities into concrete system architecture and sequencing decisions.

​

About You

You're a fit for the role of Lead AI Engineer if you have the following required qualifications:

Extensive experience architecting and shipping production software systems, including hands-on experience building AI/LLM-powered products or agentic systems (not solely classical ML/data science).

Direct experience building with modern LLM APIs, agent frameworks/SDKs, or agent-to-tool integration protocols.

A track record of setting technical direction across multiple concurrent initiatives, not just delivering one project end-to-end.

Strong backend engineering fundamentals, including distributed systems design, service architecture, and cloud infrastructure.

Experience designing for production reliability and observability: monitoring, evaluation pipelines, incident response, and quality regression detection.

Demonstrated ability to mentor senior engineers and influence technical culture and practices.

Comfort operating with high autonomy on a fast-moving, senior-heavy team that builds with AI-native/agentic engineering practices.

​

Additional preferred qualifications include:

Experience leading architecture for developer-facing platforms, plugin/extension systems, or integration ecosystems.

Familiarity with progressive delivery practices (feature flagging, phased rollout, blue/green deployment) at scale.

Experience pushing a team toward elite software delivery practices: progressive delivery, shift-left quality/testing, and the kind of engineering discipline reflected in metrics like deployment frequency, lead time, and change failure rate.

Experience with managed agent runtime infrastructure (e.g., AWS Bedrock AgentCore or similar).

PURPOSE AND SCOPE:

The professional registered nurse Outpatient RN CAP 1 is an entry level designation into the Clinical Advancement Program (CAP). This position is accountable and responsible for the provision and coordination of clinically competent care including assessment, planning, intervention and evaluation for an assigned group of patients. This may include delegation of appropriate tasks to direct patient care staff including but not limited to RNs, LVN/LPNs and Patient Care Technicians. As a member of the End Stage Kidney Disease (ESKD) health care team, this position participates in decision-making, teaching, leadership functions, and quality improvement activities that enhance patient care outcomes and facility operations.

PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

All duties and responsibilities are expected to be performed in accordance with Fresenius Kidney Care policy, procedures, standards of nursing practice, state and federal regulations.

· Performs all essential functions under the direction of the Supervisor and with guidance from the Clinical Educator, Preceptor or in collaboration with other Registered Nurses.

· Performs ongoing, systematic collection and analysis of patient data pre – during – post hemodialysis treatment for assigned patients and documents in the patient medical record, makes adjustments or modifications to treatment plan as indicated and notifies Team Leader, Charge Nurse, Supervisor or Physician as needed.

· Assesses, collaborates, and documents patient/family’s basic learning needs to provide initial and ongoing education to patients and family.

· Directs and provides, in collaboration with direct and ancillary patient care staff, all aspects of the daily provision of safe and effective delivery of hemodialysis therapy to assigned patients.

· Administers medications as prescribed or in accordance with approved algorithm(s), and documents appropriate medical justification and effectiveness.

· Initiates or assists with emergency response measures.

· Serves as a resource for health care team, participates in staff training and orientation of new staff as assigned.

· Ensures correct laboratory collection, processing and shipping procedures are performed and reschedules missed or insufficient laboratory collections.

· Identifies expected outcomes, documents and updates the nursing assessment and plan of care for assigned patients through collaboration with the Interdisciplinary Team.

· Ensures patient awareness related to transplant and treatment modality options.

· Required to complete CAP requirements to advance.

· Performs all other duties as assigned by Supervisor.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORKING CONDITIONS:

The physical demands and work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

· The position provides direct patient care that regularly involves heavy lifting, moving of patients and assisting with ambulation. Equipment aids and/or coworkers may provide assistance.

· This position requires frequent, prolonged periods of standing and the employee must be able to bend over.

· The employee may occasionally be required to move, with assistance, machines and equipment of up to 200 lbs., and may lift chemical and water solutions of up to 30 lbs. as high as 5 feet.

· The work environment is characteristic of a health care facility with air temperature control and moderate noise levels.

· May be exposed to infectious and contagious diseases/materials.

· Day to day work includes desk work, computer work, interaction with patients, facility/hospital staff and physicians.

· The position may require travel to training sites or other facilities.

· May be asked to provide essential functions of this position in other locations with the same physical demands and working conditions as described above.

SUPERVISION:

Assigned oversight of Patient Care Technicians/LPNs/LVNs/RNs as a Team Leader or designated Nurse in Charge, after meeting all the following:

· Successful completion of all FKC education and training requirements for new employees.

· Must have a minimum of 9 months experience as a RN.

· Must have a minimum of 3 months experience in chronic/acute hemodialysis as a RN.

EDUCATION and LICENSURE:

· Graduate of an accredited School of Nursing.

· Current appropriate state licensure.

· Current or successful completion of CPR BLS Certification.

· Must meet the practice requirements in the state in which he or she is employed.

EXPERIENCE AND REQUIRED SKILLS:

· Entry level for RNs with less than 2 years of Nephrology Nursing experience as a Registered Nurse.

· Chronic/acute hemodialysis experience (preferred).

Additional Details: This position will be located in Las Vegas supporting the Raiderettes and Professional Women’s Hockey League. The sports dietitian will roll up through Rehab Services while reporting to the sports nutrition Clinical Nutrition Manager

Essential Functions

Provides Medical Nutrition Therapy to individuals with multifactorial and highly dynamic complex disease states requiring frequent evaluation, monitoring, and adjustment in interventions.

Summary:

The Data Catalog Delivery Lead plays a critical role in driving the execution and operational delivery of the Enterprise Data Catalog in a consistent, scalable, and audit-ready manner. This role is responsible for governing execution across the Data Catalog Team, ensuring alignment between Product, Metadata Governance, and Operations. This role is accountable for scaling the Data Catalog to achieve targeted adoption, metadata coverage, and business usage outcomes. This role partners closely with Product Management, Metadata Governance, and Engagement teams to ensure alignment between design intent, delivery execution, and enterprise outcomes. 

The Data Catalog Delivery Lead owns end-to-end delivery execution within the Data Catalog team, ensuring design, development, and testing are aligned and production-ready. This role also establishes and reinforces design quality standards across the Data Catalog team, ensuring all solutions meet enterprise expectations for scalability, governance, and usability. While not the primary design authority, the Data Catalog Delivery Lead acts as a critical reviewer and challenger of design decisions, ensuring designs are complete, consistent, and capable of operating reliably at enterprise scale. 

In addition, this role applies strong product and design thinking principles to execution, ensuring solutions are aligned to user needs, personas, and intended outcomes ensuring delivery reflects how users will actually interact with and derive value from the catalog. The Data Catalog Delivery Lead ensures that delivery reflects a user-centered, persona-driven approach, reinforcing that the catalog is designed to enable intuitive, high-value experiences for business and technical users. 

Duties and Responsibilities: 

Own the execution governance model for the Design & Delivery team, ensuring adherence to defined operating processes, standards, and agile practices. 

Owns audit-ready execution, including traceability from requirements through design, development, testing, and release with documented evidence 

Own release management processes, including alignment to enterprise change freeze calendars, readiness validation, and deployment timing 

Plan, coordinate, and own release management processes, including readiness validation, change coordination, and deployment alignment. 

Review and challenge design decisions to ensure solutions meet enterprise expectations for scalability, governance, integration, and long-term sustainability. 

Review testing strategies and test cases to ensure alignment with functionality, user experience, and enterprise standards. 

Ensure delivery activities align to defined patterns and repeatable execution models, reinforcing consistency and reducing variability across implementations, 

Participate in agile ceremonies, ensures user story quality, including clear acceptance criteria, defined dependencies, and adherence to Definition of Ready and Definition of Done f 

Own and drive Alation platform capability, including configuration, adoption, integration, and vendor engagement 

Represent Data Catalog delivery and drive alignment across Product, Metadata Governance, and Data Safeguarding, including resolving cross-functional conflicts 

Own resolution of execution risks, requirement gaps, and design inconsistencies to maintain delivery commitments 

Ensure delivery practices support long-term scalability, audit expectations, AI readiness, and integration maturity across the catalog ecosystem. 

Accountable for driving measurable outcomes, including catalog adoption, metadata quality improvement, onboarding velocity, and audit performance 

Basic Qualifications: 

Bachelor's Degree or equivalent relevant work experience 

7+ years of experience implementing data governance frameworks (e.g., data policies, standards, and controls), experience developing and/or implementing data governance policy and standards, and experience working with IT and/or business segments on the analysis of complex business processes and data governance needs 

Proven experience in data governance, data privacy, and data protection 

2+ years hands-on experience with Alation required, including configuration of workflows, stewardship models, metadata ingestion, and platform integration processes for data catalog governance 

Preferred Qualifications: 

Proven experience in data governance, data privacy, and data protection 

Demonstrated experience implementing and enforcing structured operating models, delivery patterns, or execution frameworks across teams 

Strong understanding of testing strategies, quality assurance processes, and release management practices 

Ability to challenge decisions, drive alignment, and resolve cross-functional conflicts to maintain delivery momentum 

Experience supporting audit, regulatory, or compliance-driven delivery environments with a focus on documentation, controls, and evidence 

Proven ability to coordinate cross-functional teams and manage dependencies across product, design, and engineering functions 

Familiarity with metadata integration, data lineage, and governance processes in modern data ecosystems 

Experience working with vendor platforms, including managing support, enhancements, and technical coordination 

Strong communication and leadership skills with the ability to influence execution discipline without direct authority 

Ability to identify operational gaps and drive continuous improvement in delivery processes and team performance 

Strategic mindset with the ability to balance immediate delivery needs with long-term platform scalability and maturity

Job Description:
As a Senior Software Engineer, you will play a key role in designing and delivering high‑quality software solutions to solve complex business problems. You will be expected to work independently with minimal supervision, while collaborating effectively with cross‑functional teams. This role requires strong analytical skills, solid engineering practices, and a customer‑focused mindset. You will contribute across multiple facets of the project lifecycle in a fast‑paced, growth‑oriented environment.

About the Role:
In this opportunity as Senior Software Engineer, you will:

Design, develop, and maintain software solutions by studying information needs, systems flow, data usage, and work processes, and by engaging with users and stakeholders.

Follow and enhance the software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, design, implementation, testing, deployment, and support.

Determine operational feasibility by evaluating analysis, problem definition, requirements, solution options, and proposed implementations.

Document and demonstrate solutions by creating technical documentation, flowcharts, layouts, diagrams, charts, code comments, and clear, maintainable code.

Prepare, configure, and install solutions by defining and designing system specifications, standards, and programming approaches.

Improve operations by conducting systems analysis and recommending enhancements to applications, processes, policies, and procedures.

Safeguard systems and data by following secure coding practices and ensuring confidential handling of information.

Provide insights by collecting, analysing, and summarizing development and service issues, and contributing to continuous improvement.

Develop high‑quality software that meets user needs in terms of functionality, performance, and usability.

Collaborate with team members to brainstorm, prototype, and build new features and products.

Contribute to the growth of the engineering team by participating in interviewing, onboarding, and knowledge‑sharing activities.

Make informed, data‑driven decisions quickly and take ownership of services and applications operating at scale.

Work collaboratively and constructively with others to achieve team and organizational goals.

Demonstrate persistence and creativity in solving complex technical and product problems.

Operate effectively under pressure and remain calm and solution‑oriented in critical situations.

Stay current with modern development practices, tools, and frameworks, and advocate for engineering excellence.

Show passion for technology, with a strong interest in open‑source tools, frameworks, and libraries.

Understand business needs and translate them into robust, scalable technical solutions and tools.

About You:
You're a fit for the role of Senior Software Engineer if your background includes:

7+ years of experience as a software development with professional web application development.

Strong hands‑on experience with .NET, C#, SQL Server, OOPS, React JS, JavaScript, Typescript, Microservices, Azure Cloud, Artificial Intelligence Technologies; Asynchronous Programming; Dependency Injection; Design Patterns; Datadog, NoSQL Databases; Problem Solving; RESTful API Design; Software Development; Unit Testing.

Solid technical foundation with a strong understanding and practical application of OOP and SOLID principles.

Experience developing backend services and APIs in C#, and front‑end components using modern frameworks such as Angular and React.

Ability to research, evaluate, and implement solutions to algorithmic, performance, and platform problems.

Proven experience building and delivering complex web systems into production environments.

Demonstrated ability to take a project from requirements scoping through design, implementation, testing, deployment, and support.

Experience working with mission‑critical, high‑availability (24x7) systems.

Familiarity with professional software engineering best practices including coding standards, code reviews, source control (e.g., Git), build and release pipelines, automated testing, and monitoring/operations.

Strong desire and ability to learn new technologies, frameworks, and tools as needed.

Job Description:
The Registered Nurse (RN) is a professional caregiver who assumes responsibility and accountability for assessing, planning, implementing, and evaluating the care of patients. The staff RN utilizes the nursing process by use of technology, therapeutic intervention, evidence-based practice and coordination of care with other health team members.

Full time, 36 hours a week, nights

Benefits eligible

Essential Functions

Assess: Performs appropriate assessment of physical, social, and psychological status (including cognitive, communicative, and developmental skills as appropriate). Seeks and evaluates information acquired from other members of interdisciplinary team: patient, family, physician, non-nursing disciplines, support staff, others.

Plan: Uses assessment information and critical thinking skills to collaboratively develop individualized plan of care. Actively seeks patient, family, team, and physician involvement to develop plan of care including needed education. Collaboratively plans and prepares patients for further support needs once the current episode of care outcomes are met (i.e., teaching, referrals, and follow-up).

Implement: Directs the interdisciplinary care team via delegation, coordination, and collaboration as appropriate. Provides or delegates care consistent with plan of care, guidelines of care and professional licensure provisions. Demonstrates the ability to set priorities and to coordinate and organize patient care delivery through effectively managing time, supplies, and resources.

Evaluate: Evaluates patient response to interventions through review of achievement of goals, clinical outcomes, patient, and family satisfaction. Revises plan of care as indicated and reassesses changes as appropriate.

Professionalism: Promotes nursing profession and participate in development of others.
Integrates legal and ethical standards into practice, complies with regulatory standards, practices within scope of licensure, provides accurate & timely documentation, and understands legal implications of care delivery.

Skills

Patient Care Delivery

Nursing Fundamentals

Interdisciplinary Teams

Documentations

Professional Etiquette

Accountability

Patient Care Coordination

Communication

Patient Evaluation

Critical Thinking

Minimum Qualifications

Current license to practice as a Registered Nurse in state of practice. Valid compact licenses must be transferred to the state of practice within 60 days of the start of employment.

RNs must have their Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN) or willing to obtain within four (4) years of their hire date.

Basic Life Support Certification (BLS) for healthcare providers.

Preferred Qualifications 

One or more years of RN work experience in a hospital setting

Maternity RN work experience

*Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN) is required as of the job description's last update on 4/27/2025. Employees hired or promoted prior to this date will be held to the minimum requirements that were in place at the time of their promotion or hire.

Physical Requirements

Ongoing need for employee to see and read information, labels, assess patient needs, operate monitors, identify equipment and supplies.

Frequent interactions with patient care providers, patients, and visitors that require employee to verbally communicate as well as hear and understand spoken information, alarms, needs, and issues quickly and accurately, particularly during emergency situations.

Manual dexterity of hands and fingers to manipulate complex and delicate equipment with precision and accuracy. This includes frequent computer use and typing for documenting patient care, accessing needed information, medication preparation, etc.

Expected to lift and utilize full range of movement to transfer patients. Will also bend to retrieve, lift, and carry supplies and equipment. Typically includes items of varying weights, up to and including heavy items.

Need to walk and assist with transporting/ambulating patients and obtaining and distributing supplies and equipment. This includes pushing/pulling gurneys and portable equipment, including heavy items. Often required to navigate crowded and busy rooms (full of equipment, power cords on the floor, etc.)

May be expected to stand in a stationary position for an extended period of time.

For roles requiring driving: Expected to drive a vehicle which requires sitting, seeing and reading signs, traffic signals, and other vehicles.

The professional registered nurse Outpatient RN CAP 1 is an entry level designation into the Clinical Advancement Program (CAP). This may include delegation of appropriate tasks to direct patient care staff including but not limited to RNs, LVN/LPNs and Patient Care Technicians. As a member of the End Stage Kidney Disease (ESKD) health care team, this position participates in decision-making, teaching, leadership functions, and quality improvement activities that enhance patient care outcomes and facility operations.

PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

All duties and responsibilities are expected to be performed in accordance with Fresenius Kidney Care policy, procedures, standards of nursing practice, state and federal regulations.

· Performs all essential functions under the direction of the Supervisor and with guidance from the Clinical Educator, Preceptor or in collaboration with other Registered Nurses.

· Performs ongoing, systematic collection and analysis of patient data pre – during – post hemodialysis treatment for assigned patients and documents in the patient medical record, makes adjustments or modifications to treatment plan as indicated and notifies Team Leader, Charge Nurse, Supervisor or Physician as needed.

· Assesses, collaborates, and documents patient/family’s basic learning needs to provide initial and ongoing education to patients and family.

· Directs and provides, in collaboration with direct and ancillary patient care staff, all aspects of the daily provision of safe and effective delivery of hemodialysis therapy to assigned patients.

· Administers medications as prescribed or in accordance with approved algorithm(s), and documents appropriate medical justification and effectiveness.

· Initiates or assists with emergency response measures.

· Serves as a resource for health care team, participates in staff training and orientation of new staff as assigned.

· Ensures correct laboratory collection, processing and shipping procedures are performed and reschedules missed or insufficient laboratory collections.

· Identifies expected outcomes, documents and updates the nursing assessment and plan of care for assigned patients through collaboration with the Interdisciplinary Team.

· Ensures patient awareness related to transplant and treatment modality options.

· Required to complete CAP requirements to advance.

· Performs all other duties as assigned by Supervisor.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORKING CONDITIONS:

The physical demands and work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

· The position provides direct patient care that regularly involves heavy lifting, moving of patients and assisting with ambulation. Equipment aids and/or coworkers may provide assistance.

· This position requires frequent, prolonged periods of standing and the employee must be able to bend over.

· The employee may occasionally be required to move, with assistance, machines and equipment of up to 200 lbs., and may lift chemical and water solutions of up to 30 lbs. as high as 5 feet.

· The work environment is characteristic of a health care facility with air temperature control and moderate noise levels.

· May be exposed to infectious and contagious diseases/materials.

· Day to day work includes desk work, computer work, interaction with patients, facility/hospital staff and physicians.

· The position may require travel to training sites or other facilities.

· May be asked to provide essential functions of this position in other locations with the same physical demands and working conditions as described above.

SUPERVISION:

Assigned oversight of Patient Care Technicians/LPNs/LVNs/RNs as a Team Leader or designated Nurse in Charge, after meeting all the following:

· Successful completion of all FKC education and training requirements for new employees.

· Must have a minimum of 9 months experience as a RN.

· Must have a minimum of 3 months experience in chronic/acute hemodialysis as a RN.

EDUCATION and LICENSURE:

· Graduate of an accredited School of Nursing.

· Current appropriate state licensure.

· Current or successful completion of CPR BLS Certification.

· Must meet the practice requirements in the state in which he or she is employed.

EXPERIENCE AND REQUIRED SKILLS:

· Entry level for RNs with less than 2 years of Nephrology Nursing experience as a Registered Nurse.

· Chronic/acute hemodialysis experience (preferred).

THE OPPORTUNITY

The Business Advisor supports designated groups of 5-7 business owners as they complete the main 10KSB deliverables: a written growth plan and growth pitch. A Business Advisor typically oversees 2 groups of business owners.

The Goldman Sachs 10,000 Small Businesses program is part of a national investment by the Goldman Sachs Foundation to unlock the growth and job creation potential of small businesses and is based on the broadly held view of leading experts that a combination of education, business support services, and access to capital best addresses the barriers to growth for small businesses. The Goldman Sachs 10,000 Small Businesses program is comprised of three main components: business education, business support services (technical assistance and customized, one-on-one business advising) and the opportunity to access capital. The ultimate goal of the initiative is for the participating business owners to increase their revenues and create jobs in their community and surrounding areas.
Babson College is the national education partner for 10,000 Small Businesses. Babson College created the program curriculum and oversees training and program delivery at community college partner sites across the country.

About the Role As a Staff Software Engineer on the Platform team, you will own the technical direction of Alpaca's streaming platform - our Redpanda-based event backbone and the user-facing streaming infrastructure. Platform also owns Authentication, Developer Experience and QA, and AI-Native Engineering. Streaming is roughly two-thirds of the job and where we expect you to become the deepest engineer in the company; across the other three you review the designs, hold an informed opinion, and lead the work where they meet streaming. This is a Staff role, so we are hiring for direction as much as delivery - the engineer who decides what the streaming platform looks like in two years, writes the RFC that gets three teams to agree, and then builds the hard part. We own client-facing and internal services, maintain shared libraries nearly every team depends on, and manage our own deployments. Most of our time goes into Go, but we also write Helm charts, dig through logs and metrics, and get pulled into a wide variety of problems. Things You Get To Do Own the architecture of our event streaming platform end to end - Redpanda, the UTS ecosystem, client libraries and user-facing streaming - and set its two-to-three-year direction Lead the shift from batch to event-driven across Alpaca's systems, working with the teams who own them rather than around them Design user-facing streaming at scale: connection fan-out, slow consumers, backpressure, ordering and delivery guarantees, and the failure modes that only show up on a volatile market day Set the standards for event-driven design - schema evolution, topic ownership, replay, idempotency - and own the shared libraries other teams build against, including the cost of versioning and deprecation Shape AuthN/AuthZ direction across Alpaca and lead the work where identity meets streaming: authorizing real-time subscriptions, token lifecycle on long-lived connections, multi-tenant isolation Help shape how Alpaca builds with AI - the schemas, contracts and event streams you own are the substrate our agentic development platform runs on Partner with SRE on chaos testing and game days for the event backbone, and with our QA stream on test tooling and pre-production gates, so resilience is verified rather than assumed Lead through influence rather than authority, and multiply the engineers around you through mentoring, design review, and handing off the work that grows people Join the Platform on-call rotation and act as technical lead during incidents affecting shared infrastructure Who You Are (must-haves) 8+ years of professional engineering experience, including several years running systems at real scale. You write Go, or have deep experience in another strongly-typed language and will pick it up quickly. You have architected event streaming systems, not just used them - real production depth in Kafka or Redpanda across partitioning, consumer groups, rebalancing, retention and delivery guarantees, and how each breaks under load. You have delivered realtime data to clients at scale (WebSockets, SSE or gRPC streaming) and handled fan-out, slow consumers and backpressure in production. You have driven technical direction across team boundaries without formal authority. You can point to the decisions you owned, the RFCs you wrote, and what happened next. You have built or maintained libraries many teams depend on, and know what backward compatibility and deprecation actually cost. You have mentored senior engineers and left the teams around you better than you found them. You have real depth in at least one adjacent area - identity and access, developer tooling and CI, or testing and resilience - and genuine curiosity about the others. You know Kubernetes beyond the basics: you can write a Helm chart with relative ease, you understand security best practices, and you have job experience or certifications to prove it. You have worked with relational databases - we use PostgreSQL, but we are not picky as long as the fundamentals are solid. You have worked at a startup before - you thrive in ambiguous environments, embrace changing priorities, know when to balance technical debt with speed, and proactively tackle whatever needs to get done without relying on pre-existing processes or documentation. Who You Might Be (nice-to-haves) You’ve worked with an IDL or binary serialization format (Protobuf, Avro; we use FlatBuffers) and handled schema evolution across many consumers. You have experience with change data capture (Debezium, PeerDB or similar) and understand how Postgres logical replication works. You’ve worked on auth systems - OAuth 2.0, OIDC, JWT lifecycle, Keycloak or Cognito - especially around long-lived connections or machine-to-machine access. You’ve built agentic or AI-native developer tooling, or designed systems meant to be operated by agents rather than only by people. You’ve run chaos engineering or game days, or built the load and fault-injection testing that makes them worth running. You’ve done IaC with Argo CD or Terraform. You have experience with Grafana’s observability stack - Prometheus, Tempo and all the rest. You might have even written a PromQL query for a new alert once or twice. You’ve worked in fintech or another regulated domain and understand how compliance constraints shape architecture. The Patient Service Representative (PSR) serves as the first connection between Intermountain and patients. This role embodies Intermountain values and focuses on establishing collaborative relationships with patients and fellow caregivers to deliver the highest level of customer/patient satisfaction. The PSR ensures a superior customer experience by identifying and resolving patient needs related to patient intake and care, which may include greeting and checking-in/out patients, as well as verifying information supplied by patients.
Essential Functions.

Provides courteous and professional connections with patients over the phone, in person or via secure messaging.  Resolves patient needs skills to ensure a superior customer experience by identifying and resolving patient needs related to patient intake and care.

Documents all phone calls accurately and completely in the electronic medical record (EMR).

Schedules patient appointments for visits, procedures, diagnostic tests, referrals, and/or consultations.

Professional manner and strong interpersonal and communication skills.

Ability to protect privacy, confidentiality, and Protected Health Information (PHI) of patients, members, and caregivers.

Preferred Qualifications 

One year of customer service experience involving interactions with customers in person and by phone.

Billing and collections experience.

Computer literacy in using electronic medical records (EMR) systems and other relevant software.

High school diploma or GED preferred.

Multilingual

Ongoing need for caregivers to see and read information, labels, documents, monitors, identify equipment and supplies, and be able to assess customer needs.
