ABOUT YOU:



You've helped build or scale a customer support organization before, and you know the fundamentals: how to balance cost and quality, how to manage outsourced/BPO relationships without losing visibility into the customer experience, and how to turn operational data into decisions. You lead through your team, not around them, and you're comfortable being accountable for outcomes you don't personally execute. You're also someone senior stakeholders like Legal, Product and Engineering trust to make a fast, sound call when something is sensitive or high-stakes.





WHAT YOU’LL DO:



 - Run the day-to-day operating model across outsourced (BPO) and in-house support, translating company strategy into how the team executes

 - Own core support KPIs (customer satisfaction, resolution time, quality, and cost per contact), setting team-level targets within broader operating goals

 - Help build a world-class team that delivers high-touch, highly responsive support: set the service standard, hire and coach to it, and hold it consistently as the business grows

 - Lead with a people-first approach: hire, develop, and empower the team, and shape team structure and career paths, so the team stays healthy and delivers great customer experiences

 - Manage our BPO relationships, holding vendors accountable for performance standards and keeping cost and capacity on track against budget

 - Lead workforce and capacity planning across in-house and BPO teams, including quarterly forecasts and staffing recommendations, working with data and analytics teams to turn operational data into decisions

 - Manage our public reputation and reviews program (such as Trustpilot, Better Business Bureau, and app stores), turning customer sentiment into operational improvement

 - Provide leadership on Trust & Compliance casework, including content moderation, DMCA, and privacy, guiding specialists and helping protect our platform and community while meeting our legal and regulatory obligations

 - Partner with Legal and Trust teams to make sound, timely decisions on sensitive or high-stakes escalations, escalating to senior leadership when needed

 - Collaborate with internal training and quality teams to keep standards, coaching, and agent readiness sharp as products and policies evolve

 - Partner closely with the teams that own support tooling, automation/AI, and product to turn customer feedback into better tools and product decisions, and keep bug triage and escalation handoffs running smoothly

 - Drive operational change and continuous improvement alongside the Customer Operations leadership team, introducing new tools, processes, and ways of working that make support better for customers and for the team




WHAT YOU HAVE:



 - 8+ years in customer support or customer operations, including 5+ years in people leadership, managing both individual contributors and the leads who run a function

 - Track record of leading through others: hiring and developing leads who each own a specialized area and are accountable for results

 - Experience building a high-touch, customer-obsessed support team, with the judgment to tailor service to what different customers need

 - Experience managing outsourced/BPO vendor relationships in a growing support organization, including performance management and cost accountability

 - Strong command of support KPIs and the levers that move them (CSAT, resolution time, cost per contact, quality scores), plus experience with contact center operations and forecasting

 - Comfort with data: able to build and analyze reports in a support platform like Zendesk, and work fluently in spreadsheet tools like Google Sheets

 - A builder’s mindset, energized by designing and improving processes rather than just maintaining them

 - Familiarity with AI-enabled support tools and comfort introducing them to enhance team efficiency and improve customers’ experiences

 - Executive presence and cross-functional influence, comfortable representing customer operations to senior leadership and peer functions

 - Familiarity with trust & safety, content moderation, DMCA, or privacy, or the ability to build fluency quickly in a regulated, high-stakes domain

Join Cleveland Clinic’s Heart, Vascular & Thoracic Institute and become a part of one of the most respected healthcare organizations in the world. Cleveland Clinic has been recognized as one of the top hospitals in the country for cardiac care. The Heart, Vascular & Thoracic Institute cares for patients with a variety of heart, vascular and thoracic diseases and provides the highest level of patient care, innovative treatments and a welcoming environment to all. 

 

We are currently welcoming New Graduate RN Residents to join J61, a highly specialized 24-bed cardiovascular telemetry unit. Alongside our sister unit, J63, J61 provides expert care for post-open heart, surgical, and ventricular assist device (VAD) patients. These fast-paced units offer exceptional opportunities for professional growth, clinical advancement, and hands-on experience with innovative cardiovascular procedures. Nurses care for a diverse patient population, including individuals recovering from coronary artery bypass grafting (CABG), minimally invasive and robotic heart surgery, valve repair and replacement, VAD implantation, aneurysm repair, and other complex cardiac interventions, as well as patients with heart failure, arrhythmias, angina, and pacemaker or defibrillator procedures.

The professional registered nurse Outpatient RN CAP 1 is an entry level designation into the Clinical Advancement Program (CAP). Are you a commercially driven software sales professional with a proven ability to grow existing customer relationships, identify new revenue opportunities and expand account value?

Thomson Reuters is looking for an experienced Growth Account Manager to accelerate growth across an assigned portfolio of corporate customers in Australia and New Zealand.

This is a quota-carrying sales role focused on expanding existing customer relationships, identifying cross-sell opportunities, increasing customer penetration and driving incremental revenue across the Thomson Reuters software portfolio.

You will work closely with existing customers to understand their evolving business needs, identify opportunities where additional Thomson Reuters solutions can deliver value and lead commercial opportunities from initial engagement through negotiation and close.

Success in this role requires strong commercial judgement, proactive account development, consultative selling and the ability to build trusted relationships with senior customer stakeholders.

 

Key Responsibilities

In this opportunity as a Growth Account Manager, Corporate Software ANZ, you will:

 

Own and exceed an assigned sales target across a defined portfolio of existing corporate customers.

Proactively identify, develop and close cross-sell and expansion opportunities across the Thomson Reuters software portfolio.

Develop account growth plans that identify customer whitespace, additional product opportunities and areas for increased account penetration.

Build and maintain strong relationships with CFOs, Tax leaders, Finance executives, Technology teams and other key decision-makers.

Conduct regular customer engagement and discovery to understand changing business priorities, operational challenges and future technology requirements.

Generate qualified sales pipeline through proactive account engagement, targeted campaigns, customer referrals and collaboration with internal teams.

Identify opportunities to introduce additional Thomson Reuters solutions into existing customer environments.

Lead commercial sales opportunities from qualification and discovery through solution development, negotiation and contract execution.

Partner with Solution Consulting, Product, Professional Services and Customer Success to develop compelling customer propositions.

Work closely with Customer Success to identify expansion opportunities, support customer engagement and ensure alignment between customer outcomes and commercial growth.

Develop business cases and articulate the commercial value and return on investment of additional Thomson Reuters solutions.

Identify competitive displacement opportunities within existing accounts.

Maintain strong opportunity qualification, account plans, pipeline coverage and forecast accuracy.

Ensure appropriate coordination with Field BDMs to maintain clear account ownership and maximise growth opportunities.

Maintain a strong understanding of the Thomson Reuters software portfolio, competitive landscape and evolving customer requirements.

 

 

Deliverables (Measure of Success)

 

Achievement and over-performance against annual sales quota.

Growth in revenue across assigned existing customer accounts.

Consistent creation of qualified cross-sell and expansion pipeline.

Increased adoption of additional Thomson Reuters solutions across the assigned portfolio.

Improved customer penetration and identification of new buying centres.

Successful conversion of expansion opportunities into closed revenue.

Strong customer engagement and effective account growth planning.

Consistent pipeline coverage, opportunity progression and forecast accuracy.

Effective collaboration with Customer Success and other internal stakeholders to support sustainable account growth.

 

 

Required Qualifications

Job Summary:

The Communications Director works to magnify engagement in the arts across multiple audiences, advance goals and priorities of the campus arts community, and build on a national profile for the arts at UW-Madison. The Communications Director leads a group of 6 professional communications staff, oversees the department's strategy and budget, determines the personnel resource allocation plan, and ensures a cohesive voice and brand identity for all communications. The Communications Director develops and implements a strategic communications plan for the area. The Communications Director reports to the Senior Director for Arts and Media and serves on the leadership team, working collaboratively on the implementation of a strategic vision for the arts on campus. 

The Communications Director may be asked to represent the Senior Director at appropriate meetings and events with stakeholders and is responsible for building and maintaining strong relationships with high-level campus communicators, the media, and professional organizations. This position also works closely with colleagues in the arts across campus in conjunction with the Office of Strategic Communication on aligning with campus branding and communications. 

The department the Communications Director oversees is the Division of the Arts communications team which currently includes specialists in web design, writing, video, and social media. The Communications Director oversees specific internal, local and national strategies for those units as well as collaborating with individual faculty and staff, departments, non-academic units, and deans to uplift and promote their priorities in the arts and media and collectively raise the profile of arts and culture initiatives through all media. This position is expected to attend events hosted by the Division of the Arts and campus arts partners as assigned, including some evening and weekend events.

The Senior Director for Arts and Media reports to the Provost's Office and serves as a connector and supporter of the arts across campus. In support of the Senior Director's role, the Communications team promotes and provides resources for interdisciplinary collaborations, faculty, staff and student projects, and artist-in-residency programs. It does this through direct promotion in all media, and through supporting other units' efforts in these areas. This support can be both directly in the form of content creation, or indirect in ways that units or individuals identify needs. All work should lead to an ever-healthier arts and culture ecosystem throughout campus and greater visibility of that work to the state, the nation and the world. 

This position requires most work to be performed in-person, onsite, at a designated campus work location. Approximately 8 hours per week work may be performed remotely, at an offsite, non-campus work location. A period of evaluation will be required.

Key Job Responsibilities:

Creates communications content

Develops, implements, and monitors strategic communication initiatives for designated audiences and internal stakeholders to maximize engagement and strengthen collaboration efforts

Identifies, establishes, and directs media relationships and partnerships with internal and external sources

Audits and directs day-to-day operational plans to align with strategic initiatives and to meet established objectives

Identifies, proposes, and implements new or revived operational policies and procedures

Exercises supervisory authority, including hiring, transferring, suspending, promoting, managing conduct and performance, discharging, assigning, rewarding, disciplining, and/or approving hours worked of at least 2.0 full-time equivalent (FTE) employees

Division of the Arts

Support high-visibility moments. Bring the narrative infrastructure to earnings, policy milestones, and category-defining press, ensuring Affirm shows up with a clear, consumer-centered point of view. Adapt the narrative for global markets. Ensure Affirm's forward-looking narrative translates across markets with different cultural contexts around credit and lending — consistent in belief, sensitive in perspective. Job Description:

The Role

As a Director within the TechOps SRE team, you'll work closely with our engineering partners to help enable and drive initiatives from design to implementation. Our highly available multi-region Kubernetes (AWS EKS) environments are best-in-class and central to our enterprise-grade infrastructure strategy. These growing environments currently support numerous critical workloads. In this exciting role, you’ll have the opportunity to further develop and refine your skills, collaborate across numerous Fidelity teams, and continue to grow in a fun, collaborative, and rapidly changing environment. This is an extraordinary opportunity to have a direct impact on the emerging strategies of our infrastructure and deployments, while at the same time, helping enable the expansion of our business.

In addition to bringing technical leadership and influence, this role also includes supervisory responsibilities for a small group of professionals specializing in site reliability.

The Skills and Expertise You Bring

Leadership & Delivery

Provide technical and people leadership for a group of Site Reliability Engineers (SREs) / Cloud Engineers; hire, mentor, and develop a high-performing team.

Set clear goals and expectations; lead performance, career growth, and team health while fostering a culture of ownership and continuous improvement.

Own execution for reliability and cloud delivery initiatives—plan and prioritize work, remove blockers, and ensure predictable outcomes.

Partner cross-functionally with Product, and Engineering leaders to drive delivery of complex programs and platform improvements.

Establish, operate, and continuously improve on-call and incident management practices (escalation paths, runbooks, postmortems, and corrective action tracking).

Reliability & Operational Excellence (SRE)

Define, implement, and own service reliability metrics and practices, including SLIs/SLOs and error budgets, in partnership with engineering teams.

Lead blameless post-incident reviews and drive remediation to reduce repeat incidents and operational toil.

Champion automation and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) standards to improve delivery speed, reduce risk, and increase system resilience.

Required Technical Expertise

8+ years of hands-on AWS production experience crafting and managing highly available, secure, scalable systems (microservices preferred).

Skilled in crafting and deploying resilient AWS infrastructure across multiple regions and availability zones.

Production experience running Kubernetes workloads and clusters (EKS preferred), encompassing the creation and upkeep of Helm charts and reusable templates/libraries.

Hands-on CI/CD experience with Jenkins, involving writing and managing declarative pipelines and shared libraries.

Proficiency with Linux/Unix systems and shell scripting.

Programming proficiency (Python preferred).

Proficient with Git-based workflows.

Experience building and maintaining observability (logging, monitoring, alerting) using tools such as Datadog and Splunk.

Experience working within Agile delivery models (Kanban/Scrum).

Preferred / Nice to Have

Terraform experience (preferred).

CDN experience (e.g., Akamai).

Kafka experience (Apache/Confluent).

The Team

Fidelity Digital Assets®, a Fidelity Investments Company, is developing a full-service enterprise-grade platform for storing, trading, and servicing digital assets, such as Bitcoin and Ethereum.

Fidelity Digital Assets® adopts an entrepreneurial culture and startup approach while serving as one of the most innovative business units within Fidelity Investments. Our global, diverse team of hundreds of forward-thinking professionals lead with agility and creativity to build solutions that bridge the gap between traditional institutional investors and their exposure to digital assets. The firm’s tenure and experience across multiple business lines present our employees with unprecedented access to knowledge, technology, and resources that help our team reshape the future of finance.

Within Fidelity Digital Assets®, the Technical Operations team plays a key role in our initiative of moving to the cloud. The team uses AWS services to secure our network and scale our applications to ensure their up-time and team members are hands-on engineers specializing in system reliability who promote a DevOps approach, with a focus on infrastructure-as-code, security and automation.

About the Role Mercury is seeking a Business Continuity Management (BCM) Lead to build and lead an enterprise-wide continuity program as we prepare to become a bank. As part of the Risk team, this leader will establish practical standards, clear accountability, and tested capabilities to maintain critical services and recover effectively from disruptions, with direct visibility to the CRO and senior leadership. This role fills the need for a dedicated leader to coordinate BCM across the organization. The ideal candidate combines deep continuity and resilience expertise with the judgment to build a proportionate program in a fast-moving environment, working effectively with Engineering, Operations, Product, Information Security, Legal, Compliance, and business teams. The BCM Lead will own the enterprise framework, coordination, oversight, and reporting. Business and technology owners will remain accountable for their continuity plans and recovery execution.Because this is a new program, the Lead will be hands-on in the initial build: facilitating the first round of BIAs and plans side by side with owners, running exercises, and driving identified gaps through remediation. This leader will also work closely with Engineering on technology disaster recovery and with relevant teams on incident response, crisis management, and third-party resilience. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement Mercury’s enterprise BCM framework, policies, standards, governance, and operating model, with a prioritized implementation roadmap aligned to bank-launch readiness and critical services. Partner with business owners to identify critical services, conduct business impact analyses (customer, financial, operational, and regulatory), and map dependencies across people, processes, technology, facilities, and third parties, including single points of failure. Establish recovery time objectives (RTOs) and recovery point objectives (RPOs), where applicable, with business and technology owners; challenge gaps between objectives and recovery capabilities. Set standards for continuity plans and recovery procedures, and facilitate and support accountable owners in developing actionable plans and alternative operating arrangements. Coordinate business continuity with technology disaster recovery, incident response, and crisis management, with clear activation criteria, escalation paths, and communications responsibilities. Design and lead a risk-based exercise program, from tabletop simulations to end-to-end recovery tests, and drive lessons learned, remediation tracking, and verification that gaps are closed. Partner with Third-Party Risk Management and vendor owners to assess critical provider recovery capabilities, contingency arrangements, and concentration dependencies. Embed continuity considerations into new products, material business changes, and technology implementations. Establish metrics and reporting that give management and relevant committees visibility into readiness, testing outcomes, material gaps, and overdue remediation. Build and lead a growing BCM team, including hiring and developing analysts as the program scales over the next year. Deliver role-based training and promote awareness of continuity responsibilities across the organization. Support regulatory examinations and bank-launch readiness reviews with accurate documentation and evidence of recovery capability. Qualifications 10+ years of experience in business continuity management, operational resilience, disaster recovery, or a related discipline within a fintech, financial institution, technology company, or other highly regulated environment. Demonstrated experience building or materially enhancing an enterprise BCM program, including governance, implementation, testing, and reporting. Strong skills in business impact analysis, critical-service identification, dependency mapping, and recovery objective development. Experience developing actionable continuity plans and leading exercises that test recovery assumptions and expose gaps. Sufficient technical fluency to work with Engineering on cloud services, system dependencies, data recovery, and technology disaster recovery. Working knowledge of third-party risk management, including assessing critical vendor recovery capabilities, contingency arrangements and concentration risk. Proven ability to drive cross-functional remediation through influence, with a clear view of where BCM oversight ends and business or technology ownership begins. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain readiness gaps and tradeoffs to senior leadership. Experience managing a team of Business Continuity analysts. Preferred Qualifications Familiarity with banking supervisory expectations for business continuity, and operational resilience. Experience operating in a company-building or bank-building environment. Familiarity with recognized continuity standards, such as ISO 22301, and BCM tools for plan management, exercises, and issue tracking. Relevant professional certification, such as CBCP or MBCI. Leadership Attributes Pragmatic, first-principles builder who turns ambiguous needs into clear priorities and designs a program that fits Mercury’s operations and scale. Takes ownership and follows through from identified gaps to demonstrated recovery. Collaborative, low-ego, and effective across the three lines of defense. Job Description:

We have an immediate opening for an agency-experienced, talented, striving Vice President in our dynamic San Francisco Corporate and Technology practice. This is a hybrid role for a corporate communications professional with a passion for financial communications, corporate affairs and crisis management, and business storytelling applied primarily to clients in the Technology sector.

The position provides a unique opportunity to deepen consulting and leadership skills as FH serves as a strategic advisor and partner to top companies navigating reputational issues, securing leadership positions, and effectively managing stakeholders in today's environment. Candidates must love working in fast-paced environments and would enjoy getting in the mix occasionally with clients onsite in the Bay Area. 

Working closely with senior account leadership and practice heads, the VP will own communications strategy based on data, insights and experience; narrative and thought leadership development; business media strategy and excellent execution leading teams and subject matter experts across a variety of accounts.

FleishmanHillard values the importance of impact and inclusion to strengthen the bonds between us, grow our people and create spaces for everyone to thrive. We stay true to our commitment to our people and the communities in which we live and work. As part of our ongoing effort to be the world’s most inclusive agency, we are committed to seeking candidates who possess and demonstrate a profound interest in furthering our impact and inclusion goals.

Responsibilities

Serve as senior strategic advisor to day-to-day clients and executives on complex reputation challenges, financial communications, stakeholder engagement strategies, and integrated communications planning.

Collaborate with senior FH counselors around our global network to deliver best practices and counsel for client needs. 

Build and position corporate leaders as industry thought leaders and trusted voices through earned media, speaking opportunities, bylined content, and industry forum participation.

Play a central role in delivering high-quality results, actionable insights and recommendations, and day-to-day deliverables from the account team. 

Manage integrated communications programs/strategies that span earned financial communications, media relations, crisis communication and issues management, executive positioning, content strategy, stakeholder engagement, and digital channels—working efficiently under tight timelines and shifting priorities.

Project manage and support execution of critical moments and special circumstances. Coordinate with internal teams across multiple workstreams; ensure clarity on deliverables, deadlines, accountability, and strategic alignment.

Build and maintain relationships with top-tier business, feature and industry reporters and editors critical to client reputation and brand positioning. Monitor agenda-setting reporters for clients and forge relationships as needed.  

Coordinate rapid-response protocols and crisis communication efforts, serving as key communicator during sensitive issues or operational challenges.

Lead storytelling and message development that reflects sophisticated understanding of corporate client business models, investor interests, industry dynamics, stakeholder concerns, and competitive landscape.

Support team members with clear direction, remove blockers, and maintain momentum in a fast-paced, high-stakes environment.

Model excellence in client service, strategic thinking, and professional execution.

Stay sharp on the latest trends and technologies companies are using to communicate effectively with their stakeholders.  

Develop and manage high-quality written materials, including briefing materials, industry insight reports, press materials, executive communications, and planning documents. 

Be an effective and trusted resource to our clients and the extended FH network.  

Qualifications

8-10+ years of corporate communications and corporate reputation experience in an agency environment, with at least three years managing client relationships and strategic communications programs.

Expertise in the Technology sector, working with a variety of clients in enterprise B2B technologies including cloud computing, networking, AI and security.

Financial communications/IR and crisis preparedness and response experience are required. 

Demonstrated business acumen, strong analytical abilities, and critical, creative thinking.

Demonstrated strategic counsel capabilities—ability to provide senior-level advice on complex reputation challenges, develop comprehensive communications strategies, and counsel executives on stakeholder engagement and business-critical communications decisions.

Proven ability to develop and generate support for strategic, comprehensive communications plans that apply creative tactics and use a variety of communication channels.

Ability to illustrate a results-focused approach and commitment to going the extra mile for clients.

Strong media relations expertise—proven ability to build and maintain relationships with top-tier business, feature and trade reporters; develop compelling story angles; and secure quality earned media placements in premium outlets.

Executive positioning and thought leadership background— experience positioning corporate leaders as industry experts, developing speaking opportunities, managing bylined content, and building executive brand and visibility.

Exceptional organizational and project management skills— ability to manage multiple complex programs simultaneously, coordinate across teams, manage competing priorities, and deliver under tight timelines without compromising quality.

Excellent writing and research abilities with extensive experience in all forms of corporate and executive communications, from executive-level briefing documents and opinion pieces to executive talking points and scripts/presentations. 

Proven ability to build and mentor teams, develop junior- and mid-level talent, and support the career growth and professional development of others.

Energetic, self-starter and resourceful problem solver – gets things moving and keeps them on track. High attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple ongoing activities. 

Good interpersonal skills, can work effectively in a team environment, negotiate approvals diplomatically, and maintain composure and quality under deadlines in a fast-paced environment. 

Ability to join us in a hybrid model of working in-person in our San Francisco office or onsite with clients on average of 3 days per week.

Cyber Security Systems Architekt (d/m/w)

Als Teil unserer Abteilung für Avioniksysteme im Entwicklungsbüro widmen Sie sich der Entwicklung von Avionikarchitekturen für zivile und militärische Hubschrauber. Da bei Hubschraubern das Sicherheitsrisiko und dessen mögliche Auswirkungen auf die Flugsicherheit und die Mission bewältigt werden müssen, muss die Avionikarchitektur Mittel zum Schutz vor und zur Erkennung von potenziellen Cyberangriffen bereitstellen. Sie werden diese Tätigkeit in einem zivilen Umfeld mit dem Ziel der EASA-Zertifizierung eines neuen Hubschraubers oder der Zulassung einer Modifikation an einem bestehenden Hubschrauber ausüben, oder in einem militärischen Umfeld mit dem Ziel der Cybersicherheitszertifizierung eines Hubschraubers durch die jeweils zuständige Zulassungsbehörde.

Vielfalt verbindet: Arbeiten in einem diversen Umfeld, mit mehr als 140 Nationalitäten, in dem Austausch, Unterstützung und Vielfalt gelebt wird

Formalisierung der Integration der Cyber-Security-Prozesse des Engineerings in die übergreifenden Engineering-Prozesse innerhalb der Airbus Helicopters Prozesslandschaft (Process Landscape Platform) sowie Sicherstellung der Synchronisation mit den Support-Prozessen

Bewertung der Sicherheitsrisiken der Hubschrauberkonfiguration und Definition der erforderlichen Sicherheitsanforderungen für das eingebettete System, die sowohl funktionale als auch Assurance-Aspekte abdecken

In order to manage current and future projects, Airbus Helicopters is looking for you to join the team in Donauwörth as soon as possible as our new

Cyber Security Systems Architect (d/f/m)

You will join our Avionics Systems Department within the design office! This department is dedicated to the design of avionics architectures for civil and military helicopters. Since helicopters must manage the security risk and its possible impact on flight safety and the mission, the avionics architecture must provide the means of protection and detection against potential cyber attacks. Also, your role as a cyber security architect will consist in defining and developing the cyber security component of the avionics architecture, in coordination with the helicopter avionics architect.
You will be required to exercise this activity in a civilian context with the aim of certification with EASA of a new helicopter or the approval of a modification on an existing helicopter or in a military context with the aim of cyber security certification of a helicopter with the designated certification authority.

Your location

At our Donauwörth site, located on the banks of the river Danube, we develop helicopters from the initial idea to the airworthy product. Watch them take off and touch down on our own on-site test airfield.

Our Benefits for You

Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.

Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.

Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.

Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.

Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your tasks and responsibilities

Formalise in the Airbus Helicopters process landscape platform the integration of the cyber security processes of the engineering in the overall engineering processes and ensure the synchronisation with the support processes

Assess the security risks of the helicopter configuration and define the necessary security requirements, covering both functional and assurance aspects, for the embedded system

Monitor the development of security functions in accordance with their design assurance level

Formalise the compliance demonstration to airworthiness requirements and contribution to helicopter security accreditation

Desired skills and qualifications

Completed Degree (Bachelor, Master/Diploma) in Aerospace Engineering or Computer Science, including a specialisation in security either as part of the master or via an additional program

At least 5 years of experience in the field of embedded systems or in cybersecurity, including strong experience in systems engineering

Language Skills: German and English - negotiation level, French - desirable

Knowledge within aeronautical engineering standards (e.g. ARP 4754, ARP 4761, ED-202, ED-203)

Ability to master the functional expression of security mechanisms (authentication, access control, rights management, signature, firewall, encryption, segregation, intrusion detection)

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

Job Summary:
Under general supervision, this position is responsible for learning the management of a small driver count and/or non-traditional shifts (including nights and weekends), ensuring safe and timely movement of freight, load assignment, and providing best-in-class customer service. This position will be trained to ensure compliance with DOT regulations. They are responsible for all drivers' compliance and company regulations while working with internal and external contacts to ensure the accurate planning, routing, monitoring, and delivery of freight and loads.

Job Description:

Key Responsibilities:

• Learn to build and maintain positive professional relationships with drivers and safe, reliable outside carriers to ensure seamless new carrier set-up, minimize turnover, and maximize ongoing productivity

• Fill in for absent or unavailable personnel and on special projects related to optimizing fleet operations and achieving profitability

• Learn to utilize personnel management including training and orientation of drivers and/or employees including the training and assistance with internal and third party (customer) systems

• Become proficient in maximizing efficiency of fleet operations and profitability and making recommendations for continuous improvement, measuring key performance indicators, and creating, maintaining and presenting customer specific reporting and financial analysis through face-to-face interactions at customer location

• Learn to manage yard including checking/inspecting equipment, replacing parts (like mud flaps), completing repairs, etc., and coordinating with maintenance to ensure all regular preventative maintenance services are scheduled on time and all safety related mechanical issues are fixed for account equipment (as required)

• Learn to work with drivers, customers, and company personnel to resolve service issues, routing and/or planning, mechanical problems, accessorial pay related issues, etc., as they occur throughout the day and, where necessary, when on call

• Learn to maintain the Company's safety culture to include daily driver safety messages, monthly driver safety briefings, quarterly driver training, annual reviews, and enforce company policies to ensure DOT compliance and company safety requirements are being met

• Learn to assign loads and plan, route, and monitor freight movement to provide safe, on-time service and meet customer requirements, including managing freight exceptions and driver ETA adjustments based on pick-up and delivery schedules, and other environmental factors on the road

ABOUT HUT 8 Imagine the ultimate destination for those who want to work at the cutting edge of technology, energy, and infrastructure. Hut 8 is on a mission to build and operate some of the world’s largest data centers for next-generation computing workloads, including AI, Colocation, Cloud, and Bitcoin Mining. We are proud to offer interesting and challenging opportunities for individuals who want to build teams, solve problems, and make an impact from day one. If you’re an ambitious individual looking for a career that is as rewarding as it is challenging, you’ve come to the right place. ABOUT THE ROLE The Logistics & Expediting Manager owns inbound logistics, freight, and delivery scheduling for major equipment on Hut 8's data center builds - and expedites the critical-path items that decide whether we energize on time. Transformers, switchgear, generators, and chillers are the longest levers in the schedule; this role makes sure they show up when the site needs them, intact, with no surprises. Some of the key responsibilities you should expect are the following: Logistics Planning & Heavy Haul Own the inbound logistics plan for major equipment: transformers, MV/LV switchgear, generators, chillers, CDUs, and UPS systems. Plan heavy-haul routing and permits, escort and police coordination, bridge/road studies where needed, rigging and offload interfaces, and site delivery windows aligned to crane and laydown availability. Vendor Expediting Run structured expediting on critical-path POs: factory production milestone tracking, in-person or third-party factory visits, FAT scheduling coordination, and ship-date protection. Provide early warning the moment a vendor date is at risk - with a recovery option, not just the bad news. Freight & Carrier Management Select and manage freight forwarders, carriers, and heavy-haul specialists. Manage freight terms, insurance requirements, and OS&D claims; handle customs brokerage and import compliance for international equipment where applicable. Delivery Scheduling & Site Coordination Maintain the rolling delivery lookahead with the Materials Manager, superintendents, and planner/scheduler. Sequence deliveries against installation need dates and site constraints, and referee conflicts when multiple critical loads compete for the same window. Issue Resolution Resolve shipping damage, shortage, mis-delivery, and storage-in-transit issues fast, with clean documentation supporting claims and vendor accountability. Reporting & Process Report logistics status, risks, and expediting actions into the weekly project rhythm. Build Hut 8's logistics playbook: preferred carriers, routing lessons, and delivery requirements baked into future POs.   ABOUT YOU -      What we're looking for: - 6+ years in project logistics, traffic, or expediting for major capital projects - data center, power generation, oil & gas, or heavy industrial. - Hands-on heavy-haul experience: permits, routing studies, escorts, and rigging interfaces for loads in the 100k-500k+ lb class. - Vendor expediting depth: factory milestone tracking, FAT logistics, and holding OEMs accountable to ship dates. - Freight commercial fluency: Incoterms, carrier contracts, cargo insurance, and claims. - Customs/import experience for international equipment a plus. - Strong scheduling instincts and comfort working directly against a P6-driven need-date list. - Calm, solution-first operator when a load is stuck, damaged, or late. - Proficiency with logistics tracking tools and Excel; ERP exposure a plus. - Travel to factories, ports, and project sites as needed (typically 25-40%). ABOUT THE WORK ENVIRONMENT This role is full-time on site. WHAT MAKES HUT 8 A GREAT PLACE TO WORK Hut 8 offers a benefits and wellness program that includes medical, dental, vision, life, and short-term and long-term disability insurance, as well as paid time off. We are proud to invest in building the best team in the industry. At all levels of the organization, we are driven by an entrepreneurial spirit, radical transparency, and relentless growth mentality. At Hut 8, you will have the opportunity to: ▶ Work with bright, driven peers from a range of educational and professional backgrounds including software development, energy, engineering, entrepreneurship, investment banking, private equity, and management consulting ▶ Design and pitch new products, services, and other initiatives to a leadership team consisting of serial entrepreneurs and seasoned executives and backed by a board of directors consisting of industry veterans of energy, finance, and government ▶ Debate ideas and alternatives in a truly meritocratic setting where the learning curve is steep and the lessons come from both senior and junior members of the team ▶ Build a lifelong network of friends and professional connections at the cutting-edge intersection of technology, energy, and infrastructure

Position Overview
Novelis is one of the world leaders in aluminum recycling and rolling and a leading sustainable aluminum solutions provider. Responsibilities & Qualifications
The Finance team, located in Atlanta, GA, is seeking a Senior Manager, Operations Finance. The Sr. Manager, Operations Finance serves as the finance business partner to Operations, Metal Procurement, and non-Metal Procurement for Novelis North America. The role provides financial leadership, analysis, and challenge to support operational performance, cost optimization, procurement strategy, capital allocation, and enterprise-wide decision making.

Through deep business acumen, strong cross-functional partnership, and disciplined financial analysis, this role translates operational and procurement priorities into clear financial insights and actionable recommendations. The position leads the regional finance interface for metal, non-metal, operations, opex, and capex topics, ensuring clear and consistent communications and reporting, and driving robust but efficient processes around RFAs, planning and reporting. The position is the main finance point of contact for several key members of the Novelis North America management team.

Responsibilities

Support functional heads to meet annual and strategic targets by providing quality and timely analysis of metal cost, operating cost, and Capex on a monthly and quarterly basis.
Support functional heads to make effective decisions to positively impact P&L and Cash Flow
Coordinate across plants, procurement, supply chain, and finance to ensure consistent assumptions and clear communication of financial implications.
Review and challenge non-commercial RFAs, including operational, procurement, opex, and capex-related requests, to ensure sound business rationale and financial rigor.
Ensure RFA submissions include clear assumptions, sensitivity analysis, financial returns, risks, and alignment with Plan, Forecast, and Strategic Plan priorities.
Provide recommendations to support leadership decision making and improve consistency of financial evaluation across the region.
Lead the regional finance view of capex planning, tracking, and analysis, ensuring projects are financially evaluated and prioritized against business needs.
Partner with Operations and engineering stakeholders to assess project economics, timing, cash flow, operational benefits, and execution risks.
Support forecast, plan, and strategic planning processes by maintaining transparency of capex assumptions, approvals, and expected financial impacts.
Build capability within the Business Finance team by coaching managers, strengthening business acumen, and creating clear ownership across metal, non-metal, opex, and capex finance topics.
Establish scalable tools, standard processes, and consistent analytical frameworks to improve quality, speed, and transparency of decision support.
Foster a high-performing culture focused on partnership, ownership, continuous improvement, and proactive identification of business opportunities and risks.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Accounting, Finance, or a related field
7-10 years of progressive experience in Finance, including substantial period within FP&A
Demonstrated experience in financial analysis for business partnering, decision support, forecasting, planning, and capital/procurement evaluation (P&L and Cash Flow impact analysis, NPV, payback, buy vs lease, procurement saving)
Minimum 3 years of people management experience
Work experience in manufacturing organizations, preferably in a multi-national environment
Highly analytical mind and strategic thinking, with a bias for action and the ability to evaluate outcomes from multiple angles, while driving simplification and transparency
Ability to influence and constructively challenge stakeholders without authority to ensure alignment and execution
Ability to prioritize effectively under time pressure and manage complex topics simultaneously
Ability to coach and develop managers / team members
System fluency – either advanced experience or high adaptability across tools including MS Office, PowerBI, OneStream (Hyperion), and SAP

Preferred qualifications

Experience in applying strategic frameworks and tools to business and financial decision making
Experience with capital approval & allocation process / contract & RFA governance
Exposure to procurement, metal, as well as operations
Experience of developing dashboards, reporting tools, or analysis models using PowerBI or similar platforms

Job Description

Job Purpose  

​​The Principal Scientist for CX Product Insights is the technical authority and methodologist for consumer experience research across an assigned portfolio within Product Insights. You architect fit-for-purpose CX learning strategies across the end-to-end product lifecycle, from front-end exploration and ideation through launch readiness, ensuring methodological rigor, evidence quality, and decision-ready synthesis that accelerates innovation and renovation. You translate consumer needs into clear product and packaging experience requirements, influence cross-functional teams toward consumer-centric decisions, and balance speed vs. rigor based on decision risk. You elevate functional capability through coaching, playbooks/toolkits, and ways of working, and guide internal teams and suppliers to the right level of rigor for the decision at hand. You’ll partner closely with R&D (Product & Process Development, Packaging, Sensory), Marketing/Brand, Insights, Analytics, Culinary, and external suppliers to ensure consumer learning is converted into practical product, packaging, and technical decisions. 
​  

Essential Functions & Responsibilities  

​​Provide CX technical leadership for the assigned portfolio/platforms, defining key information needs tied to business and technical decisions at each development milestone. 

​Serve as subject matter expert (SME) for packaging design consumer research, providing specialized methodological expertise.  

​Architect end-to-end CX learning plans (qualitative + quantitative) from upstream exploration to downstream validation, with clear decision framing, success criteria, and evidence standards. 

​Serve as portfolio CX methodologist/SME—selecting, applying, and advising on appropriate methods across learning phases, aligning rigor to risk and timeline. 

​Translate consumer learning into clear experience requirements that guide product and packaging development, including managing design tradeoffs and aligning on what success looks like. 

​Lead high-stakes stakeholder readouts, synthesizing findings, tailoring storyline and technical depth for executive vs. technical audiences; ensure implications are clear, succinct, and actionable. 

​Serve as technical consultant to the CX team on study designs, analysis plans, and interpretation for high-stakes readouts and gate/milestone decisions 

​Evaluate, pilot, and standardize emerging CX methods and analytics (including vendor capabilities), documenting best practices, limitations, and evidence thresholds before scaling. 

​Coach and upskill scientists and partners through training, playbooks/toolkits, best practices, and consultative support, including shaping ways of working that embed CX rigor across the function. 

​Audit vendor strategy and performance for the portfolio—capability matching, scoping, quality expectations, data integrity checks, performance management, and deliverable acceptance criteria. 

​Lead multiple simultaneous workstreams with strong prioritization, operating discipline, documentation, and stakeholder communication in a fast-paced environment. 

​Provide continuity/backup coverage for the  CX leadership  team as needed. 

​Ensure compliance with data integrity, privacy, and internal research governance requirements.​ 

 

Expected Experience & Required Skills 

​​Bachelor’s degree minimum (Consumer Behavior/Psychology, Marketing Research, Engineering, Food Science, Human Factors, Industrial Design, or related STEM field), with an advanced degree preferred  

​Minimum of 6+ years (BS), 5+ years (MS) or 4+ years (PhD) in consumer/product research, consumer experience, or applied insights supporting product development and commercialization—CPG or food & beverage strongly preferred—with demonstrated progression as a technical authority across multiple brands/platforms and vendor ecosystems. 

​Recognized expertise across CX research methods (qualitative and quantitative), including end-to-end study design, instrument development, analysis planning, synthesis, and storytelling; ability to select methods based on decision risk and learning objectives. 

​Proven ability to influence product and packaging innovation/renovation decisions by translating consumer needs into clear experience requirements and decision criteria  

​Direct experience in consumer research methodology focused on packaging technical design  

​Strong technical oversight: expert scoping, critical review of study quality, and ability to QA vendor work (methods, analysis, and interpretation). 

​Clear, succinct communication across audiences, including leadership-level implications, tradeoffs, and uncertainty/limitations. 

​Demonstrated capability building: coaching, technical training, and establishing best practices/standards in a matrixed organization. 

​Strong cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management; sound escalation judgment and ability to correct misinterpretations of evidence. 

​Strong prioritization and independent execution across a complex portfolio with multiple concurrent projects. 

​Working proficiency with quantitative/statistical interpretation used in CX and product testing; comfort using and overseeing common research platforms and analysis tools (survey/testing platforms, analysis packages, dashboards/BI), consistent with internal standards. 

​Ability to travel up to 20% of the time.​ 

 

Work Environment & Schedule

To create a more agile and modern workplace, this position will be able to work virtually for up to two days each week and will be expected to work in-person at the assigned work location at least three days per workweek.

About this role:

Wells Fargo is seeking a Teller to join our National Branch Network. In this front line, customer focused role, you will support customers’ everyday banking needs through in-branch interactions, completing transactions accurately while delivering a welcoming and reliable experience. As a primary point of contact for customers, you represent the branch through strong service, attention to detail, and genuine care.

As a Teller, you will build foundational banking skills while learning about customers’ needs and introducing them to helpful products, services, and digital tools. You will identify opportunities to support customers and connect them to the right banker for more detailed product conversations. You will work closely with branch teammates to keep daily operations running smoothly and deliver a consistent, high-quality customer experience. This role offers meaningful exposure to retail banking and serves as an excellent starting point for long-term growth and career mobility, supported by Wells Fargo’s training, coaching, and team-based culture.

In this role you will:

Deliver a positive and reliable branch experience by accurately processing transactions and engaging customers with care.

Process routine service transactions (such as deposits, withdrawals, payments, and check cashing) with accuracy and attention to detail.

Welcome customers, understand their needs, and guide them to efficient ways to bank, including digital tools, self-service options, or the appropriate team member.

Build relationships, actively listen to understand everyday financial needs, and connect customers to relevant information, services, digital tools, or bankers.

Identify potential product or service needs, introduce solutions at a high level, and refer customers to a banker for detailed guidance.

Complete transactional and operational activities accurately, exercising sound judgment and managing risk in line with policies and controls.

Use strong communication and active listening skills to clarify needs and provide clear, simple solutions or next steps.

Collaborate with branch teammates to deliver strong operations and service, follow leadership direction, and escalate complex situations as needed.

Resolve routine customer questions or concerns and escalate more complex issues to ensure timely resolution.

About this Role
NorthStar Energy Services is seeking a QA/QC Engineer / Project Coordinator to join our collaborative multidisciplinary team. This dual-role position combines rigorous quality oversight with hands-on project coordination, helping ensure vendor-fabricated equipment, documentation, and engineering deliverables meet project requirements while supporting the communication and organization that keep projects progressing effectively.
What You'll Do
In this role, you will manage vendor quality from purchase order through final documentation, including vendor drawing and data review, shop surveillance, source inspections, and resolution of nonconformances. You will also perform independent QA/QC reviews of multidisciplinary engineering drawings to identify errors and interface gaps before fabrication or field execution. As Project Coordinator, you will support project managers and lead engineers by tracking deliverables, schedules, and action items; managing document flow; and helping keep vendors, disciplines, and clients aligned.
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

VENDOR QUALITY & SOURCE INSPECTION

Review vendor drawings, data sheets, calculations, weld maps, and Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs) to verify compliance with project specifications, purchase orders, and applicable codes
Establish appropriate hold, witness, and review points within vendor ITPs and lead pre-inspection meetings with fabricators and suppliers
Conduct fabrication shop surveillance and source inspections, coordinating third-party inspection agencies when required
Review welding documentation, including WPS/PQR qualifications, welder certifications, and NDE requirements and results
Witness and document shop testing activities, including hydrostatic testing, coating inspection, and dimensional verification
Review vendor final documentation and Manufacturing Record Books, including MTRs, weld maps, and inspection and test records, for acceptance prior to shipment and turnover
Support vendor qualification activities, audits, and maintenance of the approved vendor list

CROSS-DISCIPLINE DRAWING QA/QC

Perform independent QA/QC reviews of drawings across all disciplines, including mechanical, piping, civil/structural, electrical, and instrumentation & controls
Verify consistency across related deliverables, including P&IDs, plot plans, piping layouts and isometrics, one-line diagrams, and instrument indexes, with attention to tags, line numbers, and discipline interfaces
Review drawings against design basis documents, company and client standards, and applicable codes prior to issue
Coordinate squad checks and track review comments through resolution and final back-check
Develop and maintain drawing-check procedures and discipline checklists that promote consistent, repeatable quality across projects
Apply and interpret applicable codes and standards, including ASME B31.3/B31.4/B31.8, ASME BPVC Sections V, VIII, and IX, API 1104, API 650/653, AWS D1.1, Title 49 CFR Parts 190-199, and SSPC/AMPP coating standards

PROJECT COORDINATION & DELIVERABLE MANAGEMENT

Support project managers and lead engineers by tracking deliverable status, schedules, budget items, and action items across engineering disciplines
Coordinate deliverables, transmittals, and document control among internal disciplines, vendors, and the client, with proactive follow-up to keep reviews and approvals on schedule
Maintain accurate project quality documentation, including quality plans, deliverable lists, comment logs, and progress reports
Serve as the primary quality and coordination interface with vendors from purchase order award through delivery, supporting RFQs and technical bid evaluations as needed
Coordinate project meetings, document minutes and action items, and follow through to timely closure
Route, track, and support resolution of RFIs, technical queries, and design changes throughout the project lifecycle
Conduct field assessments and walkdowns to verify installed quality and help resolve vendor or construction issues
Support construction, commissioning, and startup activities, including receiving inspections, punch list resolution, and as-built documentation

About Hy-Vee

At Hy-Vee, we believe the shortest distance between two people is a smile. We're seeking people with a passion for customer service, a willingness to learn, and a commitment to being part of a team that strives to make our customers' lives easier, healthier and happier.

The Role and Why It's Important

Our Market Grille Clerks are at the center of one of the most exciting parts of the Hy-Vee store, serving up fresh, made-to-order food and creating a warm, welcoming experience for every customer who walks up to the counter. In this role, you'll keep things running smoothly by staying on top of orders, handling food safely, and working as part of a team that takes pride in quality and service.

If you enjoy a fast-paced environment, like working with food, and love making customers happy, this could be a great fit for you.

What You'll Do

No two shifts are exactly the same, but here's what you can expect:

Provide prompt, friendly customer service, greeting customers with a smile, learning their names, and going the extra mile to make every visit a positive one

Take customer orders at the Market Grille counter and answer the telephone promptly, providing helpful service including taking product orders

Review daily orders, anticipate product needs, and prepare and replenish product as necessary

Pull product from the cooler or freezer to prepare for cooking and ensure an adequate food supply is ready and on hand

Handle food safely and review the status and appearance of food for freshness at all times

Maintain a clean, sanitary work area throughout your shift

Check in product, put product away, and review invoices as needed

Run the department register, receive payment, and make change where applicable

Remove trash in a timely manner and wash dishes as necessary

Price and order product and deliver orders as needed

Work with co-workers as a team to ensure customer satisfaction and a pleasant work environment

Assist in other areas of the store as needed and take on special projects as assigned

Maintain strict adherence to personal hygiene, dress standards, and all Hy-Vee policies and store guidelines

Report to work when scheduled and on time

Your Skills

To be successful, you'll need to be able to:

Follow detailed written or verbal instructions and work through tasks with a few concrete variables

Perform simple addition and subtraction, copy figures, and count and record accurately

Understand and follow verbal or demonstrated directions and communicate supply needs orally or in writing

Work effectively as part of a team to deliver a great customer experience

Reporting Relationships

Accountable and Reports to: Store Director; Store Manager; Assistant Managers of Store Operations, Perishables, and Health Wellness Home; Food Service Director; Market Grille Department Manager; Assistant Market Grille Department Manager; Service Managers

Education and Experience

No education requirement; we will provide all the training you need to succeed

Six months or less of similar or related work experience; prior food service experience is a plus

Physical Requirements

Frequently stand and walk throughout a shift in sales, food service, or delivery areas

Where applicable to the role: ability to safely use sharp knives and blades for food preparation

Where applicable to the role: exposure to heat- and burn-related hazards associated with cooking, baking, or grilling equipment

Where applicable to the role: ability to operate a delivery vehicle in accordance with applicable DOT standards

Perform repetitive standing, walking, reaching, and bending associated with order fulfillment, POS transactions, and cleaning/sanitation duties

Working Environment

This role is performed in a store kitchen environment where things stay busy and engaging throughout your shift. You'll have exposure to noise, equipment movement, temperature extremes, and cleaning chemicals or solvents. Safety is always a priority, and training is provided to help ensure a safe and supportive work environment.

Transitional Care Unit (TCU) - Registered Nurse

A Transitional Care Unit (TCU) helps ease patients into dialysis. The first weeks of dialysis involve a great deal of adjustment, along with increased risk of hospitalization and mortality. As a TCU nurse, you will provide patients with a solid foundation to start their dialysis journey.  The TCU nurse coordinates the care and education of patients to help them feel better and make more informed decisions about their care, including choice of treatment modality—in-center or at-home dialysis.

PURPOSE AND SCOPE:

The registered professional nurse Home Therapies RN CAP 1 is an entry level designation into the Clinical Advancement Program (CAP). This position is accountable and responsible for the provision and coordination of clinically competent care including assessment, planning, intervention and evaluation for an assigned group of patients. Assesses and manages patients’ response to home dialysis training and treatment therapy by following prescribed predetermined protocols and communicates patient related issues to the physician as needed. As a member of the End Stage Kidney Disease (ESKD) health care team, this position participates in decision-making, teaching, leadership functions, and quality improvement activities that enhance patient care outcomes and facility operations.

PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

All duties and responsibilities are expected to be performed in accordance with Fresenius Kidney Care policy, procedures, standards of nursing practice, state and federal regulations.

· Performs all essential functions under the direction of the Supervisor with guidance from the Educator, Preceptor or in collaboration with another Registered Nurse.

· Performs ongoing, systematic collection and analysis of dialysis data for assigned patients and documents in the patient medical record, makes adjustments or modifications to treatment plan as indicated and notifies Supervisor or physician as needed.

· Assesses, collaborates and documents patient/family’s basic learning needs to provide initial and ongoing education to patients and family.

· Directs and provides, in collaboration with the patient, home care partner, direct and ancillary patient care staff, all aspects of the provision of safe and effective delivery of dialysis therapy to assigned patients.

· Administers medications as prescribed or in accordance with approved algorithm(s), and documents appropriate medical justification and effectiveness.

· Initiates or assists with emergency response measures.

· Serves as a resource for health care team, participates in staff training and orientation of new staff as assigned.

· Ensures correct laboratory collection, processing and shipping procedures are performed and reschedules missed or insufficient laboratory collections.

· Identifies expected outcomes, documents and updates the nursing assessment and plan of care for assigned patients through collaboration with the Interdisciplinary Team.

· Ensures patient awareness related to transplant and treatment modality options.

· Assists in the identification, evaluation, selection and education of Home Dialysis candidates and Home Partners.

· Performs assessment and identifies barriers of the Home Dialysis candidate’s home environment and partner / family readiness and ability to perform dialysis treatments in the home.

· Trains Home Dialysis patients and / or Home Partners on the safe, effective operation and maintenance of all Home Dialysis equipment and treatment supplies through an organized and formal Home Dialysis Training Program.

· Required to complete CAP requirements to advance.

· Performs all other duties as assigned by Supervisor.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORKING CONDITIONS:

JOB SUMMARY

The RN's practice is guided by the ANA Standard for Professional Nurse and Code of Ethics. The RN has knowledge of professional nursing principles, practices, concepts, and procedures as applied to the care of the patient population served. The RN records patients' medical history and symptoms help perform diagnostic tests and analyze results, operate medical equipment, administer treatment and medications, and help with patient follow-up and rehabilitation. The RN establishes a care plan or contributes to an existing plan. The plan may include activities, such as administering medication, including careful checking of dosages and avoiding interactions; starting, maintaining, and discontinuing intravenous (IV) lines for fluid, medication, blood, and blood products; administering therapies and treatments; observing the patient and recording those observations; and consulting with physicians and other healthcare clinicians. The RN teaches patients and their families how to manage their illnesses or injuries, explain post-treatment and home care needs; diet, nutrition, and exercise programs; and self-administration of medication and therapy. The RN provides direction to licensed practical nurses and nursing aides regarding patient care and delegates when appropriate.The RN supports efforts to advance clinical knowledge and skills. The RN precepts new hire staff and students. The RN assists the staff and students to seek and complete the tasks required to complete their competency skills. The RN continues to enhance their knowledge in the nursing management and care of patient problems and conditions as required. The RN may continue to improve the patients

Possess the knowledge of how to collect health data in a systematic and ongoing manner, prioritizing data collection as determined by the patient’s immediate condition or needs and involving the family. Analyzes the assessment data in determining diagnoses, and utilize the nursing diagnosis to develop, implement, evaluate and revise an appropriate patient plan of care that is family centered, developmentally and age-appropriate, and culturally relevant.

Identifies expected outcomes individualized to the patient and their specific health problems. Develops plans of care that are individualized to the patient’s condition or needs, reflecting current nursing practice that is evidence-based, providing for continuity of care, and are family centered.

Implements interventions in the plan of care. Initiates treatments, medications, emergency and resuscitative measures based on appropriate utilization of standing orders, policies and procedures. Provides nursing care to meet the physical, emotional, spiritual, and social-cultural needs of the patient and family utilizing a family-centered approach to care delivery.

Evaluates the patient’s progress toward attainment of outcomes. Evaluates one’s own nursing practice in relation to professional practice standards and relevant statutes and regulations of the system and department policies and maintains current knowledge in nursing practice. Systematically evaluates the quality and effectiveness of nursing practice.
